verses.kjv: The proverbs of Solomon the son of David, king of Israel;
verses.modern: The proverbs of Solomon the son of David, king of Israel:

verses.kjv: To know wisdom and instruction; to perceive the words of understanding;
verses.modern: to know wisdom and instruction, to discern words of understanding;

verses.kjv: To receive the instruction of wisdom, justice, and judgment, and equity;
verses.modern: to receive the instruction of wisdom, justice, judgment, and fairness;

verses.kjv: To give subtilty to the simple, to the young man knowledge and discretion.
verses.modern: to give shrewdness to the simple, and to the young man knowledge and discretion.

verses.kjv: A wise man will hear, and will increase learning; and a man of understanding shall attain unto wise counsels:
verses.modern: A wise man will hear and increase in learning, and a man of understanding will gain wise counsel:

verses.kjv: To understand a proverb, and the interpretation; the words of the wise, and their dark sayings.
verses.modern: to understand a proverb and its interpretation, the words of the wise and their riddles.

verses.kjv: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge: but fools despise wisdom and instruction.
verses.modern: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge; but fools despise wisdom and instruction.

verses.kjv: My son, hear the instruction of thy father, and forsake not the law of thy mother:
verses.modern: My son, hear the instruction of Your father, and do not forsake the teaching of Your mother.

verses.kjv: For they shall be an ornament of grace unto thy head, and chains about thy neck.
verses.modern: For they will be an ornament of grace on Your head, and chains around Your neck.

verses.kjv: My son, if sinners entice thee, consent thou not.
verses.modern: My son, if sinners entice You, do not consent.

verses.kjv: If they say, Come with us, let us lay wait for blood, let us lurk privily for the innocent without cause:
verses.modern: If they say, "Come with us; let us lie in wait for blood, let us secretly ambush the innocent without cause;

verses.kjv: Let us swallow them up alive as the grave; and whole, as those that go down into the pit:
verses.modern: let us swallow them up alive like the grave, and whole, like those who go down into the pit;

verses.kjv: We shall find all precious substance, we shall fill our houses with spoil:
verses.modern: we will find all kinds of precious goods, we will fill our houses with plunder;

verses.kjv: Cast in thy lot among us; let us all have one purse:
verses.modern: cast in your lot with us; we will all share one purse" —

verses.kjv: My son, walk not thou in the way with them; refrain thy foot from their path:
verses.modern: my son, do not walk in the way with them; keep your foot from their path.

verses.kjv: For their feet run to evil, and make haste to shed blood.
verses.modern: For their feet run to evil, and they hurry to shed blood.

verses.kjv: Surely in vain the net is spread in the sight of any bird.
verses.modern: Surely in vain the net is spread in the sight of any bird.

verses.kjv: And they lay wait for their own blood; they lurk privily for their own lives.
verses.modern: They lie in wait for their own blood; they secretly ambush their own lives.

verses.kjv: So are the ways of every one that is greedy of gain; which taketh away the life of the owners thereof.
verses.modern: Such are the ways of everyone who is greedy for gain; it takes away the life of those who possess it.

verses.kjv: Wisdom crieth without; she uttereth her voice in the streets:
verses.modern: Wisdom cries aloud outside; she raises her voice in the streets.

verses.kjv: She crieth in the chief place of concourse, in the openings of the gates: in the city she uttereth her words, saying,
verses.modern: She cries out in the chief places of gathering, at the openings of the gates; in the city she speaks her words:

verses.kjv: How long, ye simple ones, will ye love simplicity? and the scorners delight in their scorning, and fools hate knowledge?
verses.modern: "How long, you simple ones, will you love simplicity? How long will scorners delight in their scorning, and fools hate knowledge?

verses.kjv: Turn you at my reproof: behold, I will pour out my spirit unto you, I will make known my words unto you.
verses.modern: Turn at my rebuke. I will pour out my spirit to you; I will make known my words to you.

verses.kjv: Because I have called, and ye refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no man regarded;
verses.modern: Because I have called and you refused, I have stretched out my hand and no one paid heed;

verses.kjv: But ye have set at nought all my counsel, and would none of my reproof:
verses.modern: because you set at nothing all my counsel, and would have none of my rebuke,

verses.kjv: I also will laugh at your calamity; I will mock when your fear cometh;
verses.modern: I also will laugh at your calamity; I will mock when your fear comes —

verses.kjv: When your fear cometh as desolation, and your destruction cometh as a whirlwind; when distress and anguish cometh upon you.
verses.modern: when your fear comes like desolation, and your destruction comes like a whirlwind, when distress and anguish come on you.

verses.kjv: Then shall they call upon me, but I will not answer; they shall seek me early, but they shall not find me:
verses.modern: Then they will call on me, but I will not answer; they will seek me early, but they will not find me.

verses.kjv: For that they hated knowledge, and did not choose the fear of the LORD:
verses.modern: Because they hated knowledge and did not choose the fear of the LORD,

verses.kjv: They would none of my counsel: they despised all my reproof.
verses.modern: they would have none of my counsel; they despised all my rebuke.

verses.kjv: Therefore shall they eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own devices.
verses.modern: Therefore they will eat the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own devices.

verses.kjv: For the turning away of the simple shall slay them, and the prosperity of fools shall destroy them.
verses.modern: For the turning away of the simple will slay them, and the prosperity of fools will destroy them.

verses.kjv: But whoso hearkeneth unto me shall dwell safely, and shall be quiet from fear of evil.
verses.modern: But whoever listens to me will live safely, and will be at peace, without fear of evil."

chapters.summary: The father introduces the purpose of Proverbs — to give wisdom, instruction, and knowledge — and lays the foundation: the fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge. He warns his son against the enticement of sinners, and Wisdom herself cries in the streets, promising security to those who listen and ruin to those who refuse.

verses.kjv: My son, if thou wilt receive my words, and hide my commandments with thee;
verses.modern: My son, if You will receive my words and treasure up my commandments with You,

verses.kjv: So that thou incline thine ear unto wisdom, and apply thine heart to understanding;
verses.modern: so that You incline Your ear to wisdom and apply Your heart to understanding;

verses.kjv: Yea, if thou criest after knowledge, and liftest up thy voice for understanding;
verses.modern: if You cry out for knowledge and lift up Your voice for understanding;

verses.kjv: If thou seekest her as silver, and searchest for her as for hid treasures;
verses.modern: if You seek her as silver, and search for her as for hidden treasures,

verses.kjv: Then shalt thou understand the fear of the LORD, and find the knowledge of God.
verses.modern: then You will understand the fear of the LORD, and find the knowledge of God.

verses.kjv: For the LORD giveth wisdom: out of his mouth cometh knowledge and understanding.
verses.modern: For the LORD gives wisdom; out of His mouth come knowledge and understanding.

verses.kjv: He layeth up sound wisdom for the righteous: he is a buckler to them that walk uprightly.
verses.modern: He stores up sound wisdom for the righteous; he is a shield to those who walk uprightly.

verses.kjv: He keepeth the paths of judgment, and preserveth the way of his saints.
verses.modern: He guards the paths of justice, and preserves the way of His saints.

verses.kjv: Then shalt thou understand righteousness, and judgment, and equity; yea, every good path.
verses.modern: Then You will understand righteousness, justice, and fairness — every good path.

verses.kjv: When wisdom entereth into thine heart, and knowledge is pleasant unto thy soul;
verses.modern: When wisdom enters Your heart, and knowledge is pleasant to Your soul,

verses.kjv: Discretion shall preserve thee, understanding shall keep thee:
verses.modern: discretion will preserve You, and understanding will keep You,

verses.kjv: To deliver thee from the way of the evil man, from the man that speaketh froward things;
verses.modern: to deliver you from the way of the evil man, from the man who speaks perverse things,

verses.kjv: Who leave the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness;
verses.modern: who leave the paths of uprightness to walk in the ways of darkness,

verses.kjv: Who rejoice to do evil, and delight in the frowardness of the wicked;
verses.modern: who rejoice to do evil and delight in the perverseness of the wicked,

verses.kjv: Whose ways are crooked, and they froward in their paths:
verses.modern: whose ways are crooked, and who are perverse in their paths.

verses.kjv: To deliver thee from the strange woman, even from the stranger which flattereth with her words;
verses.modern: Wisdom will deliver you from the strange woman, even from the stranger who flatters with her words,

verses.kjv: Which forsaketh the guide of her youth, and forgetteth the covenant of her God.
verses.modern: who forsakes the guide of her youth and forgets the covenant of her God.

verses.kjv: For her house inclineth unto death, and her paths unto the dead.
verses.modern: For her house leans toward death, and her paths to the dead.

verses.kjv: None that go unto her return again, neither take they hold of the paths of life.
verses.modern: None who go to her return again, nor do they take hold of the paths of life.

verses.kjv: That thou mayest walk in the way of good men, and keep the paths of the righteous.
verses.modern: So you may walk in the way of good men, and keep the paths of the righteous.

verses.kjv: For the upright shall dwell in the land, and the perfect shall remain in it.
verses.modern: For the upright will live in the land, and the blameless will remain in it.

verses.kjv: But the wicked shall be cut off from the earth, and the transgressors shall be rooted out of it.
verses.modern: But the wicked will be cut off from the earth, and the transgressors will be rooted out of it.

chapters.summary: The father instructs his son to seek wisdom as eagerly as silver and hidden treasure, promising that the LORD gives wisdom and guards the paths of the just. Wisdom delivers from the way of the evil man and from the strange woman whose house leads to death.

verses.kjv: My son, forget not my law; but let thine heart keep my commandments:
verses.modern: My son, do not forget my law, but let Your heart keep my commandments.

verses.kjv: For length of days, and long life, and peace, shall they add to thee.
verses.modern: For they will add length of days, long life, and peace to You.

verses.kjv: Let not mercy and truth forsake thee: bind them about thy neck; write them upon the table of thine heart:
verses.modern: Do not let mercy and truth forsake You; bind them around Your neck; write them on the tablet of Your heart.

verses.kjv: So shalt thou find favour and good understanding in the sight of God and man.
verses.modern: So You will find favor and good understanding in the sight of God and man.

verses.kjv: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.
verses.modern: Trust in the LORD with all Your heart, and lean not on Your own understanding.

verses.kjv: In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.
verses.modern: In all Your ways acknowledge Him, and He shall direct Your paths.

verses.kjv: Be not wise in thine own eyes: fear the LORD, and depart from evil.
verses.modern: Do not be wise in Your own eyes; fear the LORD and depart from evil.

verses.kjv: It shall be health to thy navel, and marrow to thy bones.
verses.modern: It will be health to Your body and marrow to Your bones.

verses.kjv: Honour the LORD with thy substance, and with the firstfruits of all thine increase:
verses.modern: Honor the LORD with Your substance, and with the firstfruits of all Your increase.

verses.kjv: So shall thy barns be filled with plenty, and thy presses shall burst out with new wine.
verses.modern: So Your barns will be filled with plenty, and Your presses will burst out with new wine.

verses.kjv: My son, despise not the chastening of the LORD; neither be weary of his correction:
verses.modern: My son, do not despise the chastening of the LORD, nor be weary of His correction.

verses.kjv: For whom the LORD loveth he correcteth; even as a father the son in whom he delighteth.
verses.modern: For whom the LORD loves He corrects, even as a father the son in whom He delights.

verses.kjv: Happy is the man that findeth wisdom, and the man that getteth understanding.
verses.modern: Happy is the man who finds wisdom, and the man who gains understanding.

verses.kjv: For the merchandise of it is better than the merchandise of silver, and the gain thereof than fine gold.
verses.modern: For her gain is better than the gain of silver, and her profit better than fine gold.

verses.kjv: She is more precious than rubies: and all the things thou canst desire are not to be compared unto her.
verses.modern: She is more precious than rubies, and all the things you can desire cannot be compared to her.

verses.kjv: Length of days is in her right hand; and in her left hand riches and honour.
verses.modern: Length of days is in her right hand, and in her left hand are riches and honor.

verses.kjv: Her ways are ways of pleasantness, and all her paths are peace.
verses.modern: Her ways are ways of pleasantness, and all her paths are peace.

verses.kjv: She is a tree of life to them that lay hold upon her: and happy is every one that retaineth her.
verses.modern: She is a tree of life to those who lay hold of her, and happy is everyone who keeps her.

verses.kjv: The LORD by wisdom hath founded the earth; by understanding hath he established the heavens.
verses.modern: By wisdom the LORD has founded the earth; by understanding He has established the heavens.

verses.kjv: By his knowledge the depths are broken up, and the clouds drop down the dew.
verses.modern: By His knowledge the depths are broken open, and the clouds drop down the dew.

verses.kjv: My son, let not them depart from thine eyes: keep sound wisdom and discretion:
verses.modern: My son, do not let them depart from Your eyes; keep sound wisdom and discretion.

verses.kjv: So shall they be life unto thy soul, and grace to thy neck.
verses.modern: So they will be life to Your soul and grace to Your neck.

verses.kjv: Then shalt thou walk in thy way safely, and thy foot shall not stumble.
verses.modern: Then You will walk on Your way safely, and Your foot will not stumble.

verses.kjv: When thou liest down, thou shalt not be afraid: yea, thou shalt lie down, and thy sleep shall be sweet.
verses.modern: When You lie down, You will not be afraid; You will lie down, and Your sleep will be sweet.

verses.kjv: Be not afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it cometh.
verses.modern: Do not be afraid of sudden fear, nor of the desolation of the wicked when it comes.

verses.kjv: For the LORD shall be thy confidence, and shall keep thy foot from being taken.
verses.modern: For the LORD will be Your confidence, and will keep Your foot from being caught.

verses.kjv: Withhold not good from them to whom it is due, when it is in the power of thine hand to do it.
verses.modern: Do not withhold good from those to whom it is due, when it is in the power of Your hand to do it.

verses.modern: Do not say to Your neighbor, "Go, and come again, and tomorrow I will give," when You have it with You.

verses.kjv: Devise not evil against thy neighbour, seeing he dwelleth securely by thee.

verses.kjv: Strive not with a man without cause, if he have done thee no harm.
verses.modern: Do not contend with a man without cause, if he has done you no harm.

verses.kjv: Envy thou not the oppressor, and choose none of his ways.
verses.modern: Do not envy the oppressor, and choose none of His ways.

verses.kjv: For the froward is abomination to the LORD: but his secret is with the righteous.
verses.modern: For the perverse are an abomination to the LORD; but His secret is with the righteous.

verses.kjv: The curse of the LORD is in the house of the wicked: but he blesseth the habitation of the just.
verses.modern: The curse of the LORD is on the house of the wicked; but he blesses the habitation of the just.

verses.kjv: Surely he scorneth the scorners: but he giveth grace to the lowly.
verses.modern: Surely He scorns the scorners; but He gives grace to the lowly.

verses.kjv: The wise shall inherit glory: but shame shall be the promotion of fools.
verses.modern: The wise will inherit glory; but shame will be the promotion of fools.

chapters.summary: The father urges his son to trust in the LORD with all his heart and lean not on his own understanding, promising that God directs the paths of those who acknowledge Him in all their ways. He exalts wisdom as more precious than rubies and as the very means by which God founded the earth.

verses.kjv: Hear, ye children, the instruction of a father, and attend to know understanding.
verses.modern: Listen, my children, to the instruction of a father, and pay attention to know understanding.

verses.kjv: For I give you good doctrine, forsake ye not my law.
verses.modern: For I give you good doctrine; do not forsake my law.

verses.kjv: For I was my father's son, tender and only beloved in the sight of my mother.
verses.modern: For I was my father's son, tender and the only beloved in the sight of my mother.

verses.modern: She will place on your head an ornament of grace; a crown of glory she will deliver to you."

verses.kjv: Hear, O my son, and receive my sayings; and the years of thy life shall be many.

verses.kjv: I have taught thee in the way of wisdom; I have led thee in right paths.

verses.kjv: Take fast hold of instruction; let her not go: keep her; for she is thy life.

verses.kjv: For they eat the bread of wickedness, and drink the wine of violence.

verses.kjv: The way of the wicked is as darkness: they know not at what they stumble.

verses.kjv: My son, attend to my words; incline thine ear unto my sayings.
verses.modern: My son, pay attention to my words; incline your ear to my sayings.

verses.kjv: Let them not depart from thine eyes; keep them in the midst of thine heart.
verses.modern: Do not let them depart from your eyes; keep them in the midst of your heart.

verses.kjv: For they are life unto those that find them, and health to all their flesh.
verses.modern: For they are life to those who find them, and health to all their flesh.

verses.kjv: Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it are the issues of life.
verses.modern: Keep your heart with all diligence, for out of it are the issues of life.

verses.kjv: Put away from thee a froward mouth, and perverse lips put far from thee.

verses.kjv: Let thine eyes look right on, and let thine eyelids look straight before thee.
verses.modern: Let your eyes look straight ahead, and let your eyelids look right in front of you.

verses.kjv: Ponder the path of thy feet, and let all thy ways be established.
verses.modern: Ponder the path of your feet, and let all your ways be established.

verses.kjv: Turn not to the right hand nor to the left: remove thy foot from evil.
verses.modern: Do not turn to the right hand or to the left; remove your foot from evil.

chapters.summary: The father passes down the instruction he received from his own father, pleading with his sons to get wisdom above all else and guard their hearts, for out of them flow the issues of life. He commands them to keep their eyes fixed straight ahead and to ponder the path of their feet.

verses.kjv: My son, attend unto my wisdom, and bow thine ear to my understanding:
verses.modern: My son, pay attention to my wisdom; bow Your ear to my understanding,

verses.kjv: That thou mayest regard discretion, and that thy lips may keep knowledge.
verses.modern: so that You may keep discretion, and that Your lips may preserve knowledge.

verses.kjv: For the lips of a strange woman drop as an honeycomb, and her mouth is smoother than oil:

chapters.summary: The father warns his son against the seductive words of the strange woman, whose lips drip honey but whose end is bitter as wormwood. He urges him to drink water from his own well — to find delight in the wife of his youth — and to remember that the LORD sees every path a man takes.

verses.modern: Deliver Yourself like a roe from the hand of the hunter, and like a bird from the hand of the fowler.

verses.kjv: Can a man take fire in his bosom, and his clothes not be burned?
verses.modern: Can a man take fire to his bosom, and his clothes not be burned?

verses.kjv: Can one go upon hot coals, and his feet not be burned?

chapters.summary: The father warns against surety for a stranger, laziness (sending the sluggard to the ant for instruction), and the seven things the LORD hates: a proud look, a lying tongue, hands that shed innocent blood, a scheming heart, feet that run to evil, a false witness, and one who sows discord. He closes with a sustained warning against adultery, which brings wounds and dishonor that cannot be wiped away.

verses.modern: Her house is the way to hell, going down to the chambers of death.

chapters.summary: The father describes watching from his window as a young man without sense walks into the trap of the strange woman, who flatters him with her words and leads him to her bed. He is like an ox going to the slaughter; her house is the way to hell, going down to the chambers of death.

verses.modern: For my mouth will speak truth, and wickedness is an abomination to my lips.

verses.modern: Receive my instruction, and not silver, and knowledge rather than choice gold.

verses.modern: By me princes rule, and nobles, even all the judges of the earth.

verses.modern: I love those who love me, and those who seek me diligently will find me.

verses.kjv: Riches and honour are with me; yea, durable riches and righteousness.

chapters.summary: Wisdom calls aloud at the gates of the city, declaring that she offers truth, counsel, and strength, and that kings reign and princes decree justice by her. She reveals that she was with God before creation, brought forth before the mountains, rejoicing always before Him — and those who find her find life.

chapters.summary: Wisdom builds her house and sets her table, inviting the simple to turn in and live, while the foolish woman sits at her door and calls to the same passersby with stolen waters and secret bread. Between these two invitations stands the pivotal declaration: the fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom.

verses.kjv: Wise men lay up knowledge: but the mouth of the foolish is near destruction.

verses.modern: The blessing of the LORD makes rich, and He adds no sorrow with it.

chapters.summary: Contrasting proverbs address the difference between the wise son and the foolish, the hand of the diligent and the hand of the slack, the mouth of the righteous and the mouth of the wicked. The chapter sets the dominant pattern for the next twenty chapters: righteousness brings life, wickedness brings ruin.

verses.kjv: A false balance is abomination to the LORD: but a just weight is his delight.
verses.modern: A false balance is an abomination to the LORD; but a just weight is His delight.

verses.kjv: When pride cometh, then cometh shame: but with the lowly is wisdom.
verses.modern: When pride comes, then comes shame; but with the lowly is wisdom.

verses.kjv: The integrity of the upright shall guide them: but the perverseness of transgressors shall destroy them.
verses.modern: The integrity of the upright will guide them; but the perverseness of transgressors will destroy them.

verses.kjv: Riches profit not in the day of wrath: but righteousness delivereth from death.
verses.modern: Riches do not profit in the day of wrath; but righteousness delivers from death.

verses.kjv: The righteousness of the perfect shall direct his way: but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.
verses.modern: The righteousness of the blameless will direct his way; but the wicked will fall by his own wickedness.

verses.kjv: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them: but transgressors shall be taken in their own naughtiness.
verses.modern: The righteousness of the upright will deliver them; but transgressors will be caught in their own wickedness.

verses.kjv: When a wicked man dieth, his expectation shall perish: and the hope of unjust men perisheth.
verses.modern: When a wicked man dies, his expectation will perish, and the hope of unjust men perishes.

verses.kjv: The righteous is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked cometh in his stead.
verses.modern: The righteous is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked takes his place.

verses.kjv: An hypocrite with his mouth destroyeth his neighbour: but through knowledge shall the just be delivered.
verses.modern: A hypocrite with his mouth destroys his neighbor; but through knowledge the just will be delivered.

verses.kjv: When it goeth well with the righteous, the city rejoiceth: and when the wicked perish, there is shouting.
verses.modern: When it goes well with the righteous, the city rejoices, and when the wicked perish, there is shouting.

verses.kjv: By the blessing of the upright the city is exalted: but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.
verses.modern: By the blessing of the upright the city is exalted; but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.

verses.kjv: He that is void of wisdom despiseth his neighbour: but a man of understanding holdeth his peace.
verses.modern: He who lacks wisdom despises his neighbor; but a man of understanding holds his peace.

verses.kjv: A talebearer revealeth secrets: but he that is of a faithful spirit concealeth the matter.
verses.modern: A talebearer reveals secrets; but he who is of a faithful spirit conceals the matter.

verses.kjv: Where no counsel is, the people fall: but in the multitude of counsellors there is safety.
verses.modern: Where there is no counsel, the people fall; but in the multitude of counselors there is safety.

verses.kjv: He that is surety for a stranger shall smart for it: and he that hateth suretiship is sure.
verses.modern: He who is surety for a stranger will suffer for it, but he who hates being surety is secure.

verses.kjv: A gracious woman retaineth honour: and strong men retain riches.
verses.modern: A gracious woman retains honor, and strong men retain riches.

verses.kjv: The merciful man doeth good to his own soul: but he that is cruel troubleth his own flesh.
verses.modern: The merciful man does good for his own soul; but he who is cruel troubles his own flesh.

verses.kjv: The wicked worketh a deceitful work: but to him that soweth righteousness shall be a sure reward.
verses.modern: The wicked does a deceitful work; but to him who sows righteousness there will be a sure reward.

verses.kjv: As righteousness tendeth to life: so he that pursueth evil pursueth it to his own death.
verses.modern: As righteousness leads to life, so he who pursues evil pursues it to his own death.

verses.kjv: They that are of a froward heart are abomination to the LORD: but such as are upright in their way are his delight.
verses.modern: Those who are of a perverse heart are an abomination to the LORD; but those who are upright in their way are His delight.

verses.kjv: Though hand join in hand, the wicked shall not be unpunished: but the seed of the righteous shall be delivered.
verses.modern: Though hand join in hand, the wicked will not be unpunished; but the seed of the righteous will be delivered.

verses.kjv: As a jewel of gold in a swine's snout, so is a fair woman which is without discretion.
verses.modern: Like a jewel of gold in a swine's snout is a beautiful woman without discretion.

verses.kjv: The desire of the righteous is only good: but the expectation of the wicked is wrath.
verses.modern: The desire of the righteous is only good; but the expectation of the wicked is wrath.

verses.kjv: There is that scattereth, and yet increaseth; and there is that withholdeth more than is meet, but it tendeth to poverty.
verses.modern: There is one who scatters, yet increases more; and there is one who withholds more than is right, but it tends to poverty.

verses.kjv: The liberal soul shall be made fat: and he that watereth shall be watered also himself.
verses.modern: The generous soul will be made rich, and he who waters will himself be watered.

verses.kjv: He that withholdeth corn, the people shall curse him: but blessing shall be upon the head of him that selleth it.
verses.modern: The people will curse him who withholds grain; but blessing will be on the head of him who sells it.

verses.kjv: He that diligently seeketh good procureth favour: but he that seeketh mischief, it shall come unto him.
verses.modern: He who diligently seeks good procures favor; but he who seeks mischief, it will come to him.

verses.kjv: He that trusteth in his riches shall fall: but the righteous shall flourish as a branch.
verses.modern: He who trusts in his riches will fall; but the righteous will flourish like a branch.

verses.kjv: He that troubleth his own house shall inherit the wind: and the fool shall be servant to the wise of heart.
verses.modern: He who troubles his own house will inherit the wind, and the fool will be servant to the wise of heart.

verses.kjv: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life; and he that winneth souls is wise.
verses.modern: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life, and he who wins souls is wise.

verses.kjv: Behold, the righteous shall be recompensed in the earth: much more the wicked and the sinner.
verses.modern: If the righteous are recompensed on the earth, how much more the wicked and the sinner!

chapters.summary: Contrasting proverbs address the destruction of the wicked and the deliverance of the righteous, the ruin that pride brings and the wisdom that humility preserves. Repeated themes include the power of integrity versus the treachery of the unfaithful, and the generosity that leads to increase versus the withholding that leads to want.

verses.kjv: Whoso loveth instruction loveth knowledge: but he that hateth reproof is brutish.
verses.modern: Whoever loves instruction loves knowledge; but he who hates correction is brutish.

verses.kjv: A good man obtaineth favour of the LORD: but a man of wicked devices will he condemn.
verses.modern: A good man obtains favor from the LORD; but a man of wicked devices he will condemn.

verses.kjv: A man shall not be established by wickedness: but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.
verses.modern: A man will not be established by wickedness; but the root of the righteous will not be moved.

verses.kjv: A virtuous woman is a crown to her husband: but she that maketh ashamed is as rottenness in his bones.
verses.modern: A virtuous woman is a crown to her husband; but she who causes shame is like rottenness in His bones.

verses.kjv: The thoughts of the righteous are right: but the counsels of the wicked are deceit.
verses.modern: The thoughts of the righteous are right; but the counsels of the wicked are deceit.

verses.kjv: The words of the wicked are to lie in wait for blood: but the mouth of the upright shall deliver them.
verses.modern: The words of the wicked lie in wait for blood; but the mouth of the upright will deliver them.

verses.kjv: The wicked are overthrown, and are not: but the house of the righteous shall stand.
verses.modern: The wicked are overthrown and are no more; but the house of the righteous will stand.

verses.kjv: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom: but he that is of a perverse heart shall be despised.
verses.modern: A man will be commended according to his wisdom; but he who is of a perverse heart will be despised.

verses.kjv: He that is despised, and hath a servant, is better than he that honoureth himself, and lacketh bread.
verses.modern: He who is despised yet has a servant is better than he who honors himself yet lacks bread.

verses.kjv: A righteous man regardeth the life of his animal: but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.
verses.modern: A righteous man regards the life of his animal; but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.

verses.kjv: He that tilleth his land shall be satisfied with bread: but he that followeth vain persons is void of understanding.
verses.modern: He who tills his land will be satisfied with bread; but he who follows worthless persons lacks understanding.

verses.kjv: The wicked desireth the net of evil men: but the root of the righteous yieldeth fruit.
verses.modern: The wicked desire the spoil of evil men; but the root of the righteous yields fruit.

verses.kjv: The wicked is snared by the transgression of his lips: but the just shall come out of trouble.
verses.modern: The wicked is snared by the transgression of his lips; but the just will come out of trouble.

verses.kjv: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth: and the recompence of a man's hands shall be rendered unto him.
verses.modern: A man will be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth, and the recompense of a man's hands will be repaid to him.

verses.kjv: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes: but he that hearkeneth unto counsel is wise.
verses.modern: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes; but he who listens to counsel is wise.

verses.kjv: A fool's wrath is presently known: but a prudent man covereth shame.
verses.modern: A fool's wrath is known at once; but a prudent man covers shame.

verses.kjv: An honest witness delivereth true testimony: but a false witness deceit.
verses.modern: An honest witness delivers true testimony; but a false witness, deceit.

verses.kjv: There is that speaketh like the piercings of a sword: but the tongue of the wise is health.
verses.modern: There is one who speaks like the piercings of a sword; but the tongue of the wise brings health.

verses.kjv: The lip of truth shall be established for ever: but a lying tongue is but for a moment.
verses.modern: The lip of truth will be established forever; but a lying tongue is only for a moment.

verses.kjv: Deceit is in the heart of them that imagine evil: but to the counsellors of peace is joy.
verses.modern: Deceit is in the heart of those who plot evil; but to the counselors of peace there is joy.

verses.kjv: There shall no evil happen to the just: but the wicked shall be filled with mischief.
verses.modern: No evil will happen to the just; but the wicked will be filled with mischief.

verses.kjv: Lying lips are abomination to the LORD: but they that deal truly are his delight.
verses.modern: Lying lips are an abomination to the LORD; but those who deal truly are His delight.

verses.kjv: A prudent man concealeth knowledge: but the heart of fools proclaimeth foolishness.
verses.modern: A prudent man conceals knowledge; but the heart of fools proclaims foolishness.

verses.kjv: The hand of the diligent shall bear rule: but the slothful shall be under tribute.
verses.modern: The hand of the diligent will rule; but the slothful will be under tribute.

verses.kjv: Heaviness in the heart of man maketh it stoop: but a good word maketh it glad.
verses.modern: Heaviness in the heart of a man makes it stoop; but a good word makes it glad.

verses.kjv: The righteous is more excellent than his neighbour: but the way of the wicked seduceth them.
verses.modern: The righteous is more excellent than his neighbor; but the way of the wicked seduces them.

verses.kjv: The slothful man roasteth not that which he took in hunting: but the substance of a diligent man is precious.
verses.modern: The slothful man does not roast what he has caught; but the substance of a diligent man is precious.

verses.kjv: In the way of righteousness is life; and in the pathway thereof there is no death.
verses.modern: In the way of righteousness is life, and in its pathway there is no death.

chapters.summary: Contrasting proverbs address the value of accepting correction, the faithfulness of the righteous versus the deceit of the wicked, and the power of words to wound or to heal. The diligent hand rules while the slack hand serves, and the way of a fool is right in his own eyes.

verses.kjv: A wise son heareth his father's instruction: but a scorner heareth not rebuke.
verses.modern: A wise son hears his father's instruction; but a scorner does not listen to rebuke.

verses.kjv: A man shall eat good by the fruit of his mouth: but the soul of the transgressors shall eat violence.
verses.modern: A man will eat good by the fruit of his mouth; but the soul of the transgressors will eat violence.

verses.kjv: He that keepeth his mouth keepeth his life: but he that openeth wide his lips shall have destruction.
verses.modern: He who guards his mouth preserves his life; but he who opens wide his lips will have destruction.

verses.kjv: The soul of the sluggard desireth, and hath nothing: but the soul of the diligent shall be made fat.
verses.modern: The soul of the sluggard desires, and has nothing; but the soul of the diligent will be made rich.

verses.kjv: A righteous man hateth lying: but a wicked man is loathsome, and cometh to shame.
verses.modern: A righteous man hates lying; but a wicked man is loathsome and comes to shame.

verses.kjv: Righteousness keepeth him that is upright in the way: but wickedness overthroweth the sinner.
verses.modern: Righteousness keeps him who is upright in the way; but wickedness overthrows the sinner.

verses.kjv: There is that maketh himself rich, yet hath nothing: there is that maketh himself poor, yet hath great riches.
verses.modern: There is one who makes himself rich, yet has nothing; there is one who makes himself poor, yet has great riches.

verses.kjv: The ransom of a man's life are his riches: but the poor heareth not rebuke.
verses.modern: The ransom of a man's life is his riches; but the poor does not hear rebuke.

verses.kjv: The light of the righteous rejoiceth: but the lamp of the wicked shall be put out.
verses.modern: The light of the righteous rejoices; but the lamp of the wicked will be put out.

verses.kjv: Only by pride cometh contention: but with the well advised is wisdom.
verses.modern: Only by pride comes contention; but with the well-advised is wisdom.

verses.kjv: Wealth gotten by vanity shall be diminished: but he that gathereth by labour shall increase.
verses.modern: Wealth gotten by vanity will be diminished; but he who gathers by labor will increase.

verses.kjv: Hope deferred maketh the heart sick: but when the desire cometh, it is a tree of life.
verses.modern: Hope deferred makes the heart sick; but when the desire comes, it is a tree of life.

verses.kjv: Whoso despiseth the word shall be destroyed: but he that feareth the commandment shall be rewarded.
verses.modern: Whoever despises the word will be destroyed; but he who fears the commandment will be rewarded.

verses.kjv: The law of the wise is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.
verses.modern: The law of the wise is a fountain of life, to turn one from the snares of death.

verses.kjv: Good understanding giveth favour: but the way of transgressors is hard.
verses.modern: Good understanding gives favor; but the way of transgressors is hard.

verses.kjv: Every prudent man dealeth with knowledge: but a fool layeth open his folly.
verses.modern: Every prudent man acts with knowledge; but a fool lays open his folly.

verses.kjv: A wicked messenger falleth into mischief: but a faithful ambassador is health.
verses.modern: A wicked messenger falls into mischief; but a faithful ambassador brings health.

verses.kjv: Poverty and shame shall be to him that refuseth instruction: but he that regardeth reproof shall be honoured.
verses.modern: Poverty and shame will come to him who refuses instruction; but he who heeds correction will be honored.

verses.kjv: The desire accomplished is sweet to the soul: but it is abomination to fools to depart from evil.
verses.modern: A desire accomplished is sweet to the soul; but it is an abomination to fools to depart from evil.

verses.kjv: He that walketh with wise men shall be wise: but a companion of fools shall be destroyed.
verses.modern: He who walks with wise men will be wise; but a companion of fools will be destroyed.

verses.kjv: Evil pursueth sinners: but to the righteous good shall be repayed.
verses.modern: Evil pursues sinners; but to the righteous good will be repaid.

verses.kjv: A good man leaveth an inheritance to his children's children: and the wealth of the sinner is laid up for the just.
verses.modern: A good man leaves an inheritance to his children's children, and the wealth of the sinner is stored up for the just.

verses.kjv: Much food is in the tillage of the poor: but there is that is destroyed for want of judgment.
verses.modern: Much food is in the tillage of the poor; but there is one who is destroyed for lack of judgment.

verses.kjv: He that spareth his rod hateth his son: but he that loveth him chasteneth him betimes.
verses.modern: He who spares his rod hates his son; but he who loves him disciplines him early.

verses.kjv: The righteous eateth to the satisfying of his soul: but the belly of the wicked shall want.
verses.modern: The righteous eats to the satisfying of his soul; but the belly of the wicked will want.

chapters.summary: Contrasting proverbs address the guarding of the mouth, the fruit of diligence, the emptiness of wealth gotten by vanity, and the difference between the wise who receive instruction and the fools who despise it. Hope deferred makes the heart sick, but a desire fulfilled is a tree of life.

verses.kjv: Every wise woman buildeth her house: but the foolish plucketh it down with her hands.
verses.modern: Every wise woman builds her house; but the foolish plucks it down with her own hands.

verses.kjv: He that walketh in his uprightness feareth the LORD: but he that is perverse in his ways despiseth him.
verses.modern: He who walks in his uprightness fears the LORD; but He who is perverse in his ways despises him.

verses.kjv: In the mouth of the foolish is a rod of pride: but the lips of the wise shall preserve them.
verses.modern: In the mouth of the foolish is a rod of pride; but the lips of the wise will preserve them.

verses.kjv: Where no oxen are, the crib is clean: but much increase is by the strength of the ox.
verses.modern: Where there are no oxen, the stall is clean; but much increase comes by the strength of the ox.

verses.kjv: A faithful witness will not lie: but a false witness will utter lies.
verses.modern: A faithful witness will not lie; but a false witness will utter lies.

verses.kjv: A scorner seeketh wisdom, and findeth it not: but knowledge is easy unto him that understandeth.
verses.modern: A scorner seeks wisdom and does not find it; but knowledge is easy to Him who understands.

verses.kjv: Go from the presence of a foolish man, when thou perceivest not in him the lips of knowledge.
verses.modern: Go from the presence of a foolish man when You do not see in Him the lips of knowledge.

verses.kjv: The wisdom of the prudent is to understand his way: but the folly of fools is deceit.
verses.modern: The wisdom of the prudent is to understand His way; but the folly of fools is deceit.

verses.kjv: Fools make a mock at sin: but among the righteous there is favour.
verses.modern: Fools make a mock of sin; but among the righteous there is favor.

verses.kjv: The heart knoweth his own bitterness; and a stranger doth not intermeddle with his joy.
verses.modern: The heart knows its own bitterness, and a stranger does not share in its joy.

verses.kjv: The house of the wicked shall be overthrown: but the tabernacle of the upright shall flourish.
verses.modern: The house of the wicked will be overthrown; but the tabernacle of the upright will flourish.

verses.kjv: There is a way which seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.
verses.modern: There is a way that seems right to a man, but its end is the ways of death.

verses.kjv: Even in laughter the heart is sorrowful; and the end of that mirth is heaviness.
verses.modern: Even in laughter the heart is sorrowful, and the end of that mirth is heaviness.

verses.kjv: The backslider in heart shall be filled with his own ways: and a good man shall be satisfied from himself.
verses.modern: The backslider in heart will be filled with his own ways, and a good man will be satisfied from himself.

verses.kjv: The simple believeth every word: but the prudent man looketh well to his going.
verses.modern: The simple believes every word; but the prudent man looks well to his going.

verses.kjv: A wise man feareth, and departeth from evil: but the fool rageth, and is confident.
verses.modern: A wise man fears and departs from evil; but the fool rages and is confident.

verses.kjv: He that is soon angry dealeth foolishly: and a man of wicked devices is hated.
verses.modern: He who is soon angry deals foolishly, and a man of wicked devices is hated.

verses.kjv: The simple inherit folly: but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.
verses.modern: The simple inherit folly; but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.

verses.kjv: The evil bow before the good; and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.
verses.modern: The evil bow before the good, and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.

verses.kjv: The poor is hated even of his own neighbour: but the rich hath many friends.
verses.modern: The poor is hated even by his own neighbor; but the rich has many friends.

verses.kjv: He that despiseth his neighbour sinneth: but he that hath mercy on the poor, happy is he.
verses.modern: He who despises his neighbor sins; but he who has mercy on the poor, happy is he.

verses.kjv: Do they not err that devise evil? but mercy and truth shall be to them that devise good.
verses.modern: Do they not err who devise evil? But mercy and truth will be to those who devise good.

verses.kjv: In all labour there is profit: but the talk of the lips tendeth only to penury.
verses.modern: In all labor there is profit; but the talk of the lips leads only to poverty.

verses.kjv: The crown of the wise is their riches: but the foolishness of fools is folly.
verses.modern: The crown of the wise is their riches; but the foolishness of fools is folly.

verses.kjv: A true witness delivereth souls: but a deceitful witness speaketh lies.
verses.modern: A true witness delivers souls; but a deceitful witness speaks lies.

verses.kjv: In the fear of the LORD is strong confidence: and his children shall have a place of refuge.
verses.modern: In the fear of the LORD is strong confidence, and His children will have a place of refuge.

verses.kjv: The fear of the LORD is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.
verses.modern: The fear of the LORD is a fountain of life, to turn one from the snares of death.

verses.kjv: In the multitude of people is the king's honour: but in the want of people is the destruction of the prince.
verses.modern: In the multitude of people is the king's honor; but in the lack of people is the destruction of the prince.

verses.kjv: He that is slow to wrath is of great understanding: but he that is hasty of spirit exalteth folly.
verses.modern: He who is slow to wrath is of great understanding; but he who is hasty of spirit exalts folly.

verses.kjv: A sound heart is the life of the flesh: but envy the rottenness of the bones.
verses.modern: A sound heart is the life of the flesh; but envy is the rottenness of the bones.

verses.kjv: He that oppresseth the poor reproacheth his Maker: but he that honoureth him hath mercy on the poor.
verses.modern: He who oppresses the poor reproaches his Maker; but he who honors him has mercy on the poor.

verses.kjv: The wicked is driven away in his wickedness: but the righteous hath hope in his death.
verses.modern: The wicked is driven away in his wickedness; but the righteous has hope in his death.

verses.kjv: Wisdom resteth in the heart of him that hath understanding: but that which is in the midst of fools is made known.
verses.modern: Wisdom rests in the heart of him who has understanding; but what is in the midst of fools is made known.

verses.kjv: Righteousness exalteth a nation: but sin is a reproach to any people.
verses.modern: Righteousness exalts a nation; but sin is a reproach to any people.

verses.kjv: The king's favour is toward a wise servant: but his wrath is against him that causeth shame.
verses.modern: The king's favor is toward a wise servant; but his wrath is against him who causes shame.

chapters.summary: Contrasting proverbs address the wise woman who builds her house versus the foolish woman who tears hers down, the way that seems right to a man but ends in death, and the fear of the LORD as a fountain of life. The chapter warns against envy, hasty anger, and contempt for the poor.

verses.kjv: A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.
verses.modern: A soft answer turns away wrath; but grievous words stir up anger.

verses.kjv: The tongue of the wise useth knowledge aright: but the mouth of fools poureth out foolishness.
verses.modern: The tongue of the wise uses knowledge rightly; but the mouth of fools pours out foolishness.

verses.kjv: The eyes of the LORD are in every place, beholding the evil and the good.
verses.modern: The eyes of the LORD are in every place, watching the evil and the good.

verses.kjv: A wholesome tongue is a tree of life: but perverseness therein is a breach in the spirit.
verses.modern: A wholesome tongue is a tree of life; but perverseness in it is a breach in the spirit.

verses.kjv: A fool despiseth his father's instruction: but he that regardeth reproof is prudent.
verses.modern: A fool despises His father's instruction; but He who heeds correction is prudent.

verses.kjv: In the house of the righteous is much treasure: but in the revenues of the wicked is trouble.
verses.modern: In the house of the righteous is much treasure; but in the revenues of the wicked is trouble.

verses.kjv: The lips of the wise disperse knowledge: but the heart of the foolish doeth not so.
verses.modern: The lips of the wise spread knowledge; but the heart of the foolish does not do so.

verses.kjv: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to the LORD: but the prayer of the upright is his delight.
verses.modern: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to the LORD; but the prayer of the upright is His delight.

verses.kjv: The way of the wicked is an abomination unto the LORD: but he loveth him that followeth after righteousness.
verses.modern: The way of the wicked is an abomination to the LORD; but He loves Him who follows after righteousness.

verses.kjv: Correction is grievous unto him that forsaketh the way: and he that hateth reproof shall die.
verses.modern: Correction is grievous to Him who forsakes the way, and He who hates correction will die.

verses.kjv: Hell and destruction are before the LORD: how much more then the hearts of the children of men?
verses.modern: Hell and destruction are before the LORD; how much more then the hearts of the children of men?

verses.kjv: A scorner loveth not one that reproveth him: neither will he go unto the wise.
verses.modern: A scorner does not love one who corrects Him, nor will He go to the wise.

verses.kjv: A merry heart maketh a cheerful countenance: but by sorrow of the heart the spirit is broken.
verses.modern: A merry heart makes a cheerful countenance; but by sorrow of the heart the spirit is broken.

verses.kjv: The heart of him that hath understanding seeketh knowledge: but the mouth of fools feedeth on foolishness.
verses.modern: The heart of Him who has understanding seeks knowledge; but the mouth of fools feeds on foolishness.

verses.kjv: All the days of the afflicted are evil: but he that is of a merry heart hath a continual feast.
verses.modern: All the days of the afflicted are evil; but He who has a merry heart has a continual feast.

verses.kjv: Better is little with the fear of the LORD than great treasure and trouble therewith.
verses.modern: Better is little with the fear of the LORD than great treasure with trouble.

verses.kjv: Better is a dinner of herbs where love is, than a stalled ox and hatred therewith.
verses.modern: Better is a dinner of herbs where love is than a fatted ox with hatred.

verses.kjv: A wrathful man stirreth up strife: but he that is slow to anger appeaseth strife.
verses.modern: A wrathful man stirs up strife; but He who is longsuffering appeases strife.

verses.kjv: The way of the slothful man is as an hedge of thorns: but the way of the righteous is made plain.
verses.modern: The way of the slothful man is like a hedge of thorns; but the way of the righteous is made plain.

verses.kjv: A wise son maketh a glad father: but a foolish man despiseth his mother.
verses.modern: A wise son makes a glad father; but a foolish man despises His mother.

verses.kjv: Folly is joy to him that is destitute of wisdom: but a man of understanding walketh uprightly.
verses.modern: Folly is joy to Him who lacks wisdom; but a man of understanding walks uprightly.

verses.kjv: Without counsel purposes are disappointed: but in the multitude of counsellors they are established.
verses.modern: Without counsel, purposes are disappointed; but in the multitude of counselors they are established.

verses.kjv: A man hath joy by the answer of his mouth: and a word spoken in due season, how good is it!
verses.modern: A man has joy by the answer of his mouth, and a word spoken in due season, how good it is!

verses.kjv: The way of life is above to the wise, that he may depart from hell beneath.
verses.modern: The way of life leads upward for the wise, that He may depart from hell beneath.

verses.kjv: The LORD will destroy the house of the proud: but he will establish the border of the widow.
verses.modern: The LORD will destroy the house of the proud; but He will establish the border of the widow.

verses.kjv: The thoughts of the wicked are an abomination to the LORD: but the words of the pure are pleasant words.
verses.modern: The thoughts of the wicked are an abomination to the LORD; but the words of the pure are pleasant words.

verses.kjv: He that is greedy of gain troubleth his own house; but he that hateth gifts shall live.
verses.modern: He who is greedy for gain troubles his own house, but He who hates bribes will live.

verses.kjv: The heart of the righteous studieth to answer: but the mouth of the wicked poureth out evil things.
verses.modern: The heart of the righteous studies how to answer; but the mouth of the wicked pours out evil things.

verses.kjv: The LORD is far from the wicked: but he heareth the prayer of the righteous.
verses.modern: The LORD is far from the wicked; but he hears the prayer of the righteous.

verses.kjv: The light of the eyes rejoiceth the heart: and a good report maketh the bones fat.
verses.modern: The light of the eyes rejoices the heart, and a good report makes the bones strong.

verses.kjv: The ear that heareth the reproof of life abideth among the wise.
verses.modern: The ear that hears the correction of life will remain among the wise.

verses.kjv: He that refuseth instruction despiseth his own soul: but he that heareth reproof getteth understanding.
verses.modern: He who refuses instruction despises his own soul; but He who hears correction gains understanding.

verses.kjv: The fear of the LORD is the instruction of wisdom; and before honour is humility.
verses.modern: The fear of the LORD is the instruction of wisdom, and before honor is humility.

chapters.summary: Contrasting proverbs address the power of the tongue — a soft answer turns away wrath, but harsh words stir up anger — and the eyes of the LORD that are in every place, watching the evil and the good. Better is a little with the fear of the LORD than great treasure with trouble.

verses.kjv: The preparations of the heart in man, and the answer of the tongue, is from the LORD.
verses.modern: The preparations of the heart in man and the answer of the tongue are from the LORD.

verses.kjv: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes; but the LORD weigheth the spirits.
verses.modern: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes, but the LORD weighs the spirits.

verses.kjv: Commit thy works unto the LORD, and thy thoughts shall be established.
verses.modern: Commit Your works to the LORD, and Your thoughts will be established.

verses.kjv: The LORD hath made all things for himself: yea, even the wicked for the day of evil.
verses.modern: The LORD has made all things for Himself, even the wicked for the day of evil.

verses.kjv: Every one that is proud in heart is an abomination to the LORD: though hand join in hand, he shall not be unpunished.
verses.modern: Everyone who is proud in heart is an abomination to the LORD; though hand join in hand, He will not be unpunished.

verses.kjv: By mercy and truth iniquity is purged: and by the fear of the LORD men depart from evil.
verses.modern: By mercy and truth iniquity is purged, and by the fear of the LORD men depart from evil.

verses.kjv: When a man's ways please the LORD, he maketh even his enemies to be at peace with him.
verses.modern: When a man's ways please the LORD, He makes even His enemies to be at peace with Him.

verses.kjv: Better is a little with righteousness than great revenues without right.
verses.modern: Better is a little with righteousness than great revenues without justice.

verses.kjv: A man's heart deviseth his way: but the LORD directeth his steps.
verses.modern: A man's heart devises his way; but the LORD directs His steps.

verses.kjv: A divine sentence is in the lips of the king: his mouth transgresseth not in judgment.
verses.modern: A divine sentence is on the lips of the king; his mouth does not transgress in judgment.

verses.kjv: A just weight and balance are the LORD'S: all the weights of the bag are his work.
verses.modern: A just weight and balance are the LORD's; all the weights of the bag are His work.

verses.kjv: It is an abomination to kings to commit wickedness: for the throne is established by righteousness.
verses.modern: It is an abomination to kings to commit wickedness, for the throne is established by righteousness.

verses.kjv: Righteous lips are the delight of kings; and they love him that speaketh right.
verses.modern: Righteous lips are the delight of kings, and they love Him who speaks rightly.

verses.kjv: The wrath of a king is as messengers of death: but a wise man will pacify it.
verses.modern: The wrath of a king is like messengers of death; but a wise man will pacify it.

verses.kjv: In the light of the king's countenance is life; and his favour is as a cloud of the latter rain.
verses.modern: In the light of the king's countenance is life, and his favor is like a cloud of the latter rain.

verses.kjv: How much better is it to get wisdom than gold! and to get understanding rather to be chosen than silver!
verses.modern: How much better it is to get wisdom than gold, and to get understanding rather than silver!

verses.kjv: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil: he that keepeth his way preserveth his soul.
verses.modern: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil; he who keeps his way preserves his soul.

verses.kjv: Pride goeth before destruction, and an haughty spirit before a fall.
verses.modern: Pride goes before destruction, and a haughty spirit before a fall.

verses.kjv: Better it is to be of an humble spirit with the lowly, than to divide the spoil with the proud.
verses.modern: It is better to be of a humble spirit with the lowly than to divide the spoil with the proud.

verses.kjv: He that handleth a matter wisely shall find good: and whoso trusteth in the LORD, happy is he.
verses.modern: He who handles a matter wisely will find good, and whoever trusts in the LORD, happy is He.

verses.kjv: The wise in heart shall be called prudent: and the sweetness of the lips increaseth learning.
verses.modern: The wise in heart will be called prudent, and the sweetness of the lips increases learning.

verses.kjv: Understanding is a wellspring of life unto him that hath it: but the instruction of fools is folly.
verses.modern: Understanding is a wellspring of life to Him who has it; but the instruction of fools is folly.

verses.kjv: The heart of the wise teacheth his mouth, and addeth learning to his lips.
verses.modern: The heart of the wise teaches His mouth and adds learning to His lips.

verses.kjv: Pleasant words are as an honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.
verses.modern: Pleasant words are like a honeycomb, sweet to the soul and health to the bones.

verses.kjv: There is a way that seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.
verses.modern: There is a way that seems right to a man, but its end is the ways of death.

verses.kjv: He that laboureth laboureth for himself; for his mouth craveth it of him.
verses.modern: He who labors, labors for himself, for his mouth urges Him on.

verses.kjv: An ungodly man diggeth up evil: and in his lips there is as a burning fire.
verses.modern: An ungodly man digs up evil, and on His lips there is as a burning fire.

verses.kjv: A froward man soweth strife: and a whisperer separateth chief friends.
verses.modern: A perverse man sows strife, and a whisperer separates close friends.

verses.kjv: A violent man enticeth his neighbour, and leadeth him into the way that is not good.
verses.modern: A violent man entices His neighbor and leads Him into a way that is not good.

verses.kjv: He shutteth his eyes to devise froward things: moving his lips he bringeth evil to pass.
verses.modern: He shuts His eyes to devise perverse things; moving His lips, He brings evil to pass.

verses.kjv: The hoary head is a crown of glory, if it be found in the way of righteousness.
verses.modern: The gray head is a crown of glory, if it is found in the way of righteousness.

verses.kjv: He that is slow to anger is better than the mighty; and he that ruleth his spirit than he that taketh a city.
verses.modern: He who is longsuffering is better than the mighty, and He who rules his spirit than he who takes a city.

verses.kjv: The lot is cast into the lap; but the whole disposing thereof is of the LORD.
verses.modern: The lot is cast into the lap, but its every decision is from the LORD.

chapters.summary: Contrasting proverbs address the sovereignty of God over human plans, the heart of the king in the LORD's hand, and the pride that goes before destruction. A man's heart plans his way, but the LORD directs his steps, and a wise man's words are gracious and persuasive.

verses.kjv: Better is a dry morsel, and quietness therewith, than an house full of sacrifices with strife.
verses.modern: Better is a dry morsel with quietness than a house full of sacrifices with strife.

verses.kjv: A wise servant shall have rule over a son that causeth shame, and shall have part of the inheritance among the brethren.
verses.modern: A wise servant will rule over a son who causes shame, and will share the inheritance among the brethren.

verses.kjv: The fining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold: but the LORD trieth the hearts.
verses.modern: The refining pot is for silver and the furnace for gold; but the LORD tests the hearts.

verses.kjv: A wicked doer giveth heed to false lips; and a liar giveth ear to a naughty tongue.
verses.modern: A wicked doer gives heed to false lips, and a liar gives ear to a destructive tongue.

verses.kjv: Whoso mocketh the poor reproacheth his Maker: and he that is glad at calamities shall not be unpunished.
verses.modern: Whoever mocks the poor reproaches his Maker, and he who is glad at calamities will not be unpunished.

verses.kjv: Children's children are the crown of old men; and the glory of children are their fathers.
verses.modern: Children's children are the crown of old men, and the glory of children is their fathers.

verses.kjv: Excellent speech becometh not a fool: much less do lying lips a prince.
verses.modern: Excellent speech is not fitting for a fool, much less are lying lips for a prince.

verses.kjv: A gift is as a precious stone in the eyes of him that hath it: whithersoever it turneth, it prospereth.
verses.modern: A gift is like a precious stone in the eyes of Him who has it; wherever it turns, it prospers.

verses.kjv: He that covereth a transgression seeketh love; and he that repeateth a matter separateth very friends.
verses.modern: He who covers a transgression seeks love, but he who repeats a matter separates close friends.

verses.kjv: A reproof entereth more into a wise man than an hundred stripes into a fool.
verses.modern: A rebuke enters more deeply into a wise man than a hundred stripes into a fool.

verses.kjv: An evil man seeketh only rebellion: therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.
verses.modern: An evil man seeks only rebellion; therefore a cruel messenger will be sent against Him.

verses.kjv: Let a bear robbed of her whelps meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.
verses.modern: Let a bear robbed of her cubs meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.

verses.kjv: Whoso rewardeth evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.
verses.modern: Whoever rewards evil for good, evil will not depart from His house.

verses.kjv: The beginning of strife is as when one letteth out water: therefore leave off contention, before it be meddled with.
verses.modern: The beginning of strife is like releasing water; therefore stop contention before it breaks out.

verses.kjv: He that justifieth the wicked, and he that condemneth the just, even they both are abomination to the LORD.
verses.modern: He who justifies the wicked, and he who condemns the just, even both of them are an abomination to the LORD.

verses.kjv: Wherefore is there a price in the hand of a fool to get wisdom, seeing he hath no heart to it?
verses.modern: Why is there a price in the hand of a fool to get wisdom, when He has no heart for it?

verses.kjv: A friend loveth at all times, and a brother is born for a time of adversity.
verses.modern: A friend loves at all times, and a brother is born for a time of adversity.

verses.kjv: A man void of understanding striketh hands, and becometh surety in the presence of his friend.
verses.modern: A man without understanding strikes hands in pledge and becomes surety in the presence of His friend.

verses.kjv: He loveth transgression that loveth strife: and he that exalteth his gate seeketh destruction.
verses.modern: He who loves transgression loves strife, and he who exalts his gate seeks destruction.

verses.kjv: He that hath a froward heart findeth no good: and he that hath a perverse tongue falleth into mischief.
verses.modern: He who has a perverse heart finds no good, and he who has a perverse tongue falls into mischief.

verses.kjv: He that begetteth a fool doeth it to his sorrow: and the father of a fool hath no joy.
verses.modern: He who fathers a fool does so to his sorrow, and the father of a fool has no joy.

verses.kjv: A merry heart doeth good like a medicine: but a broken spirit drieth the bones.
verses.modern: A merry heart does good like a medicine; but a broken spirit dries the bones.

verses.kjv: A wicked man taketh a gift out of the bosom to pervert the ways of judgment.
verses.modern: A wicked man takes a gift out of the bosom to pervert the ways of judgment.

verses.kjv: Wisdom is before him that hath understanding; but the eyes of a fool are in the ends of the earth.
verses.modern: Wisdom is before Him who has understanding, but the eyes of a fool are on the ends of the earth.

verses.kjv: A foolish son is a grief to his father, and bitterness to her that bare him.
verses.modern: A foolish son is a grief to His father, and bitterness to her who bore Him.

verses.kjv: Also to punish the just is not good, nor to strike princes for equity.
verses.modern: Also, to punish the just is not good, nor to strike princes for fairness.

verses.kjv: He that hath knowledge spareth his words: and a man of understanding is of an excellent spirit.
verses.modern: He who has knowledge spares his words, and a man of understanding is of an excellent spirit.

verses.kjv: Even a fool, when he holdeth his peace, is counted wise: and he that shutteth his lips is esteemed a man of understanding.
verses.modern: Even a fool, when He holds His peace, is counted wise, and He who shuts his lips is esteemed a man of understanding.

chapters.summary: Contrasting proverbs address the value of peace over conflict, the testing of hearts by the LORD as a refiner tests silver, and the loyalty of a true friend who loves at all times. The chapter warns against mocking the poor, rejoicing at calamity, and provoking strife.

verses.kjv: Through desire a man, having separated himself, seeketh and intermeddleth with all wisdom.
verses.modern: Through desire a man who has separated himself seeks and quarrels against all sound wisdom.

verses.kjv: A fool hath no delight in understanding, but that his heart may discover itself.
verses.modern: A fool has no delight in understanding, but only in revealing His own heart.

verses.kjv: When the wicked cometh, then cometh also contempt, and with ignominy reproach.
verses.modern: When the wicked comes, contempt also comes, and with dishonor comes reproach.

verses.kjv: The words of a man's mouth are as deep waters, and the wellspring of wisdom as a flowing brook.
verses.modern: The words of a man's mouth are like deep waters, and the wellspring of wisdom like a flowing brook.

verses.kjv: It is not good to accept the person of the wicked, to overthrow the righteous in judgment.
verses.modern: It is not good to show favor to the wicked, to overthrow the righteous in judgment.

verses.kjv: A fool's lips enter into contention, and his mouth calleth for strokes.
verses.modern: A fool's lips enter into contention, and his mouth calls for blows.

verses.kjv: A fool's mouth is his destruction, and his lips are the snare of his soul.
verses.modern: A fool's mouth is his destruction, and his lips are the snare of his soul.

verses.kjv: The words of a talebearer are as wounds, and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly.
verses.modern: The words of a talebearer are like wounds, and they go down to the innermost parts of the belly.

verses.kjv: He also that is slothful in his work is brother to him that is a great waster.
verses.modern: He who is slothful in his work is brother to him who is a great waster.

verses.kjv: The name of the LORD is a strong tower: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe.
verses.modern: The name of the LORD is a strong tower; the righteous runs into it and is safe.

verses.kjv: The rich man's wealth is his strong city, and as an high wall in his own conceit.
verses.modern: The rich man's wealth is his strong city, and like a high wall in his own imagination.

verses.kjv: Before destruction the heart of man is haughty, and before honour is humility.
verses.modern: Before destruction the heart of man is haughty, and before honor is humility.

verses.kjv: He that answereth a matter before he heareth it, it is folly and shame unto him.
verses.modern: He who answers a matter before he hears it, it is folly and shame to him.

verses.kjv: The spirit of a man will sustain his infirmity; but a wounded spirit who can bear?
verses.modern: The spirit of a man will sustain his infirmity, but a wounded spirit who can bear?

verses.kjv: The heart of the prudent getteth knowledge; and the ear of the wise seeketh knowledge.
verses.modern: The heart of the prudent gains knowledge, and the ear of the wise seeks knowledge.

verses.kjv: A man's gift maketh room for him, and bringeth him before great men.
verses.modern: A man's gift makes room for him and brings him before great men.

verses.kjv: He that is first in his own cause seemeth just; but his neighbour cometh and searcheth him.
verses.modern: He who is first in his own cause seems just, but his neighbor comes and examines him.

verses.kjv: The lot causeth contentions to cease, and parteth between the mighty.
verses.modern: The lot causes contentions to cease and parts between the mighty.

verses.kjv: A brother offended is harder to be won than a strong city: and their contentions are like the bars of a castle.
verses.modern: A brother offended is harder to be won than a strong city, and their contentions are like the bars of a castle.

verses.kjv: A man's belly shall be satisfied with the fruit of his mouth; and with the increase of his lips shall he be filled.
verses.modern: A man's belly will be satisfied with the fruit of his mouth, and with the increase of his lips he will be filled.

verses.kjv: Death and life are in the power of the tongue: and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof.
verses.modern: Death and life are in the power of the tongue, and those who love it will eat its fruit.

verses.kjv: Whoso findeth a wife findeth a good thing, and obtaineth favour of the LORD.
verses.modern: Whoever finds a wife finds a good thing and obtains favor from the LORD.

verses.kjv: The poor useth intreaties; but the rich answereth roughly.
verses.modern: The poor uses entreaties, but the rich answers roughly.

verses.kjv: A man that hath friends must shew himself friendly: and there is a friend that sticketh closer than a brother.
verses.modern: A man who has friends must show himself friendly, and there is a friend who sticks closer than a brother.

chapters.summary: Contrasting proverbs address the danger of isolation, the fool who delights only in expressing his own opinion, the power of the tongue (death and life are in its power), and the name of the LORD as a strong tower where the righteous run and are safe. A man who finds a wife finds a good thing and obtains favor of the LORD.

verses.kjv: Better is the poor that walketh in his integrity, than he that is perverse in his lips, and is a fool.
verses.modern: Better is the poor who walks in His integrity than He who is perverse in his lips and is a fool.

verses.kjv: Also, that the soul be without knowledge, it is not good; and he that hasteth with his feet sinneth.
verses.modern: Also, that the soul be without knowledge is not good, and He who hastens with his feet sins.

verses.kjv: The foolishness of man perverteth his way: and his heart fretteth against the LORD.
verses.modern: The foolishness of man perverts His way, and His heart frets against the LORD.

verses.kjv: Wealth maketh many friends; but the poor is separated from his neighbour.
verses.modern: Wealth makes many friends, but the poor is separated from His neighbor.

verses.kjv: A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaketh lies shall not escape.
verses.modern: A false witness will not be unpunished, and He who speaks lies will not escape.

verses.kjv: Many will intreat the favour of the prince: and every man is a friend to him that giveth gifts.
verses.modern: Many will entreat the favor of the prince, and every man is a friend to him who gives gifts.

verses.kjv: All the brethren of the poor do hate him: how much more do his friends go far from him? he pursueth them with words, yet they are wanting to him.
verses.modern: All the brethren of the poor hate him; how much more do his friends go far from him! He pursues them with words, yet they are gone.

verses.kjv: He that getteth wisdom loveth his own soul: he that keepeth understanding shall find good.
verses.modern: He who gets wisdom loves his own soul; he who keeps understanding will find good.

verses.kjv: A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaketh lies shall perish.
verses.modern: A false witness will not be unpunished, and he who speaks lies will perish.

verses.kjv: Delight is not seemly for a fool; much less for a servant to have rule over princes.
verses.modern: Delight is not fitting for a fool, much less for a servant to rule over princes.

verses.kjv: The discretion of a man deferreth his anger; and it is his glory to pass over a transgression.
verses.modern: The discretion of a man defers his anger, and it is his glory to pass over a transgression.

verses.kjv: The king's wrath is as the roaring of a lion; but his favour is as dew upon the grass.
verses.modern: The king's wrath is like the roaring of a lion, but his favor is like dew on the grass.

verses.kjv: A foolish son is the calamity of his father: and the contentions of a wife are a continual dropping.
verses.modern: A foolish son is the calamity of his father, and the contentions of a wife are a continual dripping.

verses.kjv: House and riches are the inheritance of fathers: and a prudent wife is from the LORD.
verses.modern: House and riches are the inheritance of fathers, but a prudent wife is from the LORD.

verses.kjv: Slothfulness casteth into a deep sleep; and an idle soul shall suffer hunger.
verses.modern: Slothfulness casts into a deep sleep, and an idle soul will suffer hunger.

verses.kjv: He that keepeth the commandment keepeth his own soul; but he that despiseth his ways shall die.
verses.modern: He who keeps the commandment keeps his own soul, but He who despises his ways will die.

verses.kjv: He that hath pity upon the poor lendeth unto the LORD; and that which he hath given will he pay him again.
verses.modern: He who has pity on the poor lends to the LORD, and what He has given He will repay Him.

verses.kjv: Chasten thy son while there is hope, and let not thy soul spare for his crying.
verses.modern: Chasten Your son while there is hope, and do not let Your soul spare Him because of His crying.

verses.kjv: A man of great wrath shall suffer punishment: for if thou deliver him, yet thou must do it again.
verses.modern: A man of great wrath will suffer punishment, for if You deliver Him, You must do it again.

verses.kjv: Hear counsel, and receive instruction, that thou mayest be wise in thy latter end.
verses.modern: Hear counsel and receive instruction, that You may be wise in Your latter end.

verses.kjv: There are many devices in a man's heart; nevertheless the counsel of the LORD, that shall stand.
verses.modern: There are many devices in a man's heart, but the counsel of the LORD will stand.

verses.kjv: The desire of a man is his kindness: and a poor man is better than a liar.
verses.modern: The desire of a man is his kindness, and a poor man is better than a liar.

verses.kjv: The fear of the LORD tendeth to life: and he that hath it shall abide satisfied; he shall not be visited with evil.
verses.modern: The fear of the LORD leads to life, and He who has it will abide satisfied; he will not be visited with evil.

verses.kjv: A slothful man hideth his hand in his bosom, and will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.
verses.modern: A slothful man hides His hand in His bosom and will not even bring it to His mouth again.
