verses.kjv: Smite a scorner, and the simple will beware: and reprove one that hath understanding, and he will understand knowledge.
verses.modern: Strike a scorner, and the simple will beware; correct one who has understanding, and He will gain knowledge.

verses.kjv: He that wasteth his father, and chaseth away his mother, is a son that causeth shame, and bringeth reproach.
verses.modern: He who wastes his father and drives away his mother is a son who causes shame and brings reproach.

verses.kjv: Cease, my son, to hear the instruction that causeth to err from the words of knowledge.
verses.modern: Cease, my son, to hear the instruction that causes You to stray from the words of knowledge.

verses.kjv: An ungodly witness scorneth judgment: and the mouth of the wicked devoureth iniquity.
verses.modern: An ungodly witness scorns judgment, and the mouth of the wicked devours iniquity.

verses.kjv: Judgments are prepared for scorners, and stripes for the back of fools.
verses.modern: Judgments are prepared for scorners, and stripes for the back of fools.

chapters.summary: Contrasting proverbs address the integrity of the poor versus the perverseness of the rich fool, the value of patience and discretion, and the fear of the LORD that leads to life. The chapter warns against laziness, false witnesses, and neglecting to discipline a child while there is hope.

verses.kjv: Wine is a mocker, strong drink is raging: and whosoever is deceived thereby is not wise.
verses.modern: Wine is a mocker, strong drink is raging, and whoever is deceived by them is not wise.

verses.kjv: The fear of a king is as the roaring of a lion: whoso provoketh him to anger sinneth against his own soul.
verses.modern: The fear of a king is like the roaring of a lion; whoever provokes him to anger sins against his own soul.

verses.kjv: It is an honour for a man to cease from strife: but every fool will be meddling.
verses.modern: It is an honor for a man to cease from strife; but every fool will be meddling.

verses.kjv: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the cold; therefore shall he beg in harvest, and have nothing.
verses.modern: The sluggard will not plow because of the cold; therefore He will beg in harvest and have nothing.

verses.kjv: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water; but a man of understanding will draw it out.
verses.modern: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water, but a man of understanding will draw it out.

verses.kjv: Most men will proclaim every one his own goodness: but a faithful man who can find?
verses.modern: Most men will proclaim each His own goodness; but a faithful man who can find?

verses.kjv: The just man walketh in his integrity: his children are blessed after him.
verses.modern: The just man walks in His integrity; His children are blessed after Him.

verses.kjv: A king that sitteth in the throne of judgment scattereth away all evil with his eyes.
verses.modern: A king who sits on the throne of judgment scatters away all evil with His eyes.

verses.kjv: Who can say, I have made my heart clean, I am pure from my sin?
verses.modern: Who can say, "I have made my heart clean; I am pure from my sin"?

verses.kjv: Divers weights, and divers measures, both of them are alike abomination to the LORD.
verses.modern: Different weights and different measures, both alike are an abomination to the LORD.

verses.kjv: Even a child is known by his doings, whether his work be pure, and whether it be right.
verses.modern: Even a child is known by His doings, whether His work is pure and whether it is right.

verses.kjv: The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, the LORD hath made even both of them.
verses.modern: The hearing ear and the seeing eye, the LORD has made them both.

verses.kjv: Love not sleep, lest thou come to poverty; open thine eyes, and thou shalt be satisfied with bread.
verses.modern: Do not love sleep, lest You come to poverty; open Your eyes, and You will be satisfied with bread.

verses.kjv: It is naught, it is naught, saith the buyer: but when he is gone his way, then he boasteth.
verses.modern: "It is worthless, it is worthless," says the buyer; but when He is gone on His way, then He boasts.

verses.kjv: There is gold, and a multitude of rubies: but the lips of knowledge are a precious jewel.
verses.modern: There is gold and a multitude of rubies; but the lips of knowledge are a precious jewel.

verses.kjv: Take his garment that is surety for a stranger: and take a pledge of him for a strange woman.
verses.modern: Take the garment of Him who is surety for a stranger, and take a pledge from Him for a strange woman.

verses.kjv: Bread of deceit is sweet to a man; but afterwards his mouth shall be filled with gravel.
verses.modern: Bread of deceit is sweet to a man, but afterward his mouth will be filled with gravel.

verses.kjv: Every purpose is established by counsel: and with good advice make war.
verses.modern: Every purpose is established by counsel, and with good advice wage war.

verses.kjv: He that goeth about as a talebearer revealeth secrets: therefore meddle not with him that flattereth with his lips.
verses.modern: He who goes about as a talebearer reveals secrets; therefore do not associate with Him who flatters with His lips.

verses.kjv: Whoso curseth his father or his mother, his lamp shall be put out in obscure darkness.
verses.modern: Whoever curses his father or his mother, his lamp will be put out in deep darkness.

verses.kjv: An inheritance may be gotten hastily at the beginning; but the end thereof shall not be blessed.
verses.modern: An inheritance may be gained hastily at the beginning, but its end will not be blessed.

verses.kjv: Say not thou, I will recompense evil; but wait on the LORD, and he shall save thee.
verses.modern: Do not say, "I will repay evil"; wait on the LORD, and He will save You.

verses.kjv: Divers weights are an abomination unto the LORD; and a false balance is not good.
verses.modern: Different weights are an abomination to the LORD, and a false balance is not good.

verses.kjv: Man's goings are of the LORD; how can a man then understand his own way?
verses.modern: A man's steps are of the LORD; how then can a man understand his own way?

verses.kjv: It is a snare to the man who devoureth that which is holy, and after vows to make enquiry.
verses.modern: It is a snare for a man to vow rashly something holy, and afterward to consider His vows.

verses.kjv: A wise king scattereth the wicked, and bringeth the wheel over them.
verses.modern: A wise king scatters the wicked and brings the wheel over them.

verses.kjv: The spirit of man is the candle of the LORD, searching all the inward parts of the belly.
verses.modern: The spirit of man is the candle of the LORD, searching all the inward parts of the belly.

verses.kjv: Mercy and truth preserve the king: and his throne is upholden by mercy.
verses.modern: Mercy and truth preserve the king, and his throne is upheld by mercy.

verses.kjv: The glory of young men is their strength: and the beauty of old men is the grey head.
verses.modern: The glory of young men is their strength, and the beauty of old men is the gray head.

verses.kjv: The blueness of a wound cleanseth away evil: so do stripes the inward parts of the belly.
verses.modern: The bruises of a wound cleanse away evil, and so do stripes the inward parts of the belly.

chapters.summary: Contrasting proverbs address the deceptiveness of wine, the honor of avoiding strife, the varied weights and measures that are an abomination to the LORD, and the fact that a man's steps are directed by the LORD though he does not understand his own way. The spirit of man is the lamp of the LORD, searching his inmost being.

verses.kjv: The king's heart is in the hand of the LORD, as the rivers of water: he turneth it whithersoever he will.
verses.modern: The king's heart is in the hand of the LORD, like the rivers of water; He turns it wherever He wills.

verses.kjv: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes: but the LORD pondereth the hearts.
verses.modern: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes; but the LORD ponders the hearts.

verses.kjv: To do justice and judgment is more acceptable to the LORD than sacrifice.
verses.modern: To do justice and judgment is more acceptable to the LORD than sacrifice.

verses.kjv: An high look, and a proud heart, and the plowing of the wicked, is sin.
verses.modern: A high look, a proud heart, and the plowing of the wicked are sin.

verses.kjv: The thoughts of the diligent tend only to plenteousness; but of every one that is hasty only to want.
verses.modern: The thoughts of the diligent tend only to plenty, but of everyone who is hasty only to want.

verses.kjv: The getting of treasures by a lying tongue is a vanity tossed to and fro of them that seek death.
verses.modern: Gaining treasures by a lying tongue is a vanity tossed to and fro by those who seek death.

verses.kjv: The robbery of the wicked shall destroy them; because they refuse to do judgment.
verses.modern: The robbery of the wicked will destroy them, because they refuse to do justice.

verses.kjv: The way of man is froward and strange: but as for the pure, his work is right.
verses.modern: The way of man is perverse and strange; but as for the pure, his work is right.

verses.kjv: It is better to dwell in a corner of the housetop, than with a brawling woman in a wide house.
verses.modern: It is better to live in a corner of the housetop than with a contentious woman in a wide house.

verses.kjv: The soul of the wicked desireth evil: his neighbour findeth no favour in his eyes.
verses.modern: The soul of the wicked desires evil; his neighbor finds no favor in his eyes.

verses.kjv: When the scorner is punished, the simple is made wise: and when the wise is instructed, he receiveth knowledge.
verses.modern: When the scorner is punished, the simple is made wise, and when the wise is instructed, he receives knowledge.

verses.kjv: The righteous man wisely considereth the house of the wicked: but God overthroweth the wicked for their wickedness.
verses.modern: The righteous man wisely considers the house of the wicked; but God overthrows the wicked for their wickedness.

verses.kjv: Whoso stoppeth his ears at the cry of the poor, he also shall cry himself, but shall not be heard.
verses.modern: Whoever stops his ears at the cry of the poor will also cry himself, but will not be heard.

verses.kjv: A gift in secret pacifieth anger: and a reward in the bosom strong wrath.
verses.modern: A gift in secret pacifies anger, and a reward in the bosom, strong wrath.

verses.kjv: It is joy to the just to do judgment: but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity.
verses.modern: It is joy to the just to do justice; but destruction will come to the workers of iniquity.

verses.kjv: The man that wandereth out of the way of understanding shall remain in the congregation of the dead.
verses.modern: The man who wanders out of the way of understanding will remain in the congregation of the dead.

verses.kjv: He that loveth pleasure shall be a poor man: he that loveth wine and oil shall not be rich.
verses.modern: He who loves pleasure will be a poor man; he who loves wine and oil will not be rich.

verses.kjv: The wicked shall be a ransom for the righteous, and the transgressor for the upright.
verses.modern: The wicked will be a ransom for the righteous, and the transgressor for the upright.

verses.kjv: It is better to dwell in the wilderness, than with a contentious and an angry woman.
verses.modern: It is better to live in the wilderness than with a contentious and angry woman.

verses.kjv: There is treasure to be desired and oil in the dwelling of the wise; but a foolish man spendeth it up.
verses.modern: There is treasure to be desired and oil in the dwelling of the wise, but a foolish man squanders it.

verses.kjv: He that followeth after righteousness and mercy findeth life, righteousness, and honour.
verses.modern: He who follows after righteousness and mercy finds life, righteousness, and honor.

verses.kjv: A wise man scaleth the city of the mighty, and casteth down the strength of the confidence thereof.
verses.modern: A wise man scales the city of the mighty and casts down the strength of its confidence.

verses.kjv: Whoso keepeth his mouth and his tongue keepeth his soul from troubles.
verses.modern: Whoever keeps his mouth and his tongue keeps his soul from troubles.

verses.kjv: Proud and haughty scorner is his name, who dealeth in proud wrath.
verses.modern: Proud and haughty scorner is his name, who deals in proud wrath.

verses.kjv: The desire of the slothful killeth him; for his hands refuse to labour.
verses.modern: The desire of the slothful kills him, for his hands refuse to labor.

verses.kjv: He coveteth greedily all the day long: but the righteous giveth and spareth not.
verses.modern: He covets greedily all the day long; but the righteous gives and does not spare.

verses.kjv: The sacrifice of the wicked is abomination: how much more, when he bringeth it with a wicked mind?
verses.modern: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination; how much more when he brings it with a wicked mind!

verses.kjv: A false witness shall perish: but the man that heareth speaketh constantly.
verses.modern: A false witness will perish; but the man who hears speaks steadily.

verses.kjv: A wicked man hardeneth his face: but as for the upright, he directeth his way.
verses.modern: A wicked man hardens his face; but as for the upright, he establishes his way.

verses.kjv: There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against the LORD.
verses.modern: There is no wisdom, nor understanding, nor counsel against the LORD.

verses.kjv: The horse is prepared against the day of battle: but safety is of the LORD.
verses.modern: The horse is prepared for the day of battle; but safety is of the LORD.

chapters.summary: Contrasting proverbs address the king's heart in the LORD's hand, the sacrifice of the wicked as an abomination, and the futility of human plans against the counsel of the LORD. The chapter warns that whoever shuts his ears to the cry of the poor will himself cry and not be heard.

verses.kjv: A good name is rather to be chosen than great riches, and loving favour rather than silver and gold.
verses.modern: A good name is rather to be chosen than great riches, and loving favor rather than silver and gold.

verses.kjv: The rich and poor meet together: the LORD is the maker of them all.
verses.modern: The rich and the poor meet together; the LORD is the Maker of them all.

verses.kjv: A prudent man foreseeth the evil, and hideth himself: but the simple pass on, and are punished.
verses.modern: A prudent man foresees the evil and hides Himself; but the simple pass on and are punished.

verses.kjv: By humility and the fear of the LORD are riches, and honour, and life.
verses.modern: By humility and the fear of the LORD are riches, honor, and life.

verses.kjv: Thorns and snares are in the way of the froward: he that doth keep his soul shall be far from them.
verses.modern: Thorns and snares are in the way of the perverse; He who keeps his soul will be far from them.

verses.kjv: Train up a child in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.
verses.modern: Train up a child in the way He should go, and when He is old, He will not depart from it.

verses.kjv: The rich ruleth over the poor, and the borrower is servant to the lender.
verses.modern: The rich rules over the poor, and the borrower is servant to the lender.

verses.kjv: He that soweth iniquity shall reap vanity: and the rod of his anger shall fail.
verses.modern: He who sows iniquity will reap vanity, and the rod of His anger will fail.

verses.kjv: He that hath a bountiful eye shall be blessed; for he giveth of his bread to the poor.
verses.modern: He who has a bountiful eye will be blessed, for he gives of His bread to the poor.

verses.kjv: Cast out the scorner, and contention shall go out; yea, strife and reproach shall cease.
verses.modern: Cast out the scorner, and contention will go out; strife and reproach will cease.

verses.kjv: He that loveth pureness of heart, for the grace of his lips the king shall be his friend.
verses.modern: He who loves pureness of heart, for the grace of his lips the king will be his friend.

verses.kjv: The eyes of the LORD preserve knowledge, and he overthroweth the words of the transgressor.
verses.modern: The eyes of the LORD preserve knowledge, and He overthrows the words of the transgressor.

verses.kjv: The slothful man saith, There is a lion without, I shall be slain in the streets.
verses.modern: The slothful man says, "There is a lion outside; I will be slain in the streets!"

verses.kjv: The mouth of strange women is a deep pit: he that is abhorred of the LORD shall fall therein.
verses.modern: The mouth of strange women is a deep pit; He who is abhorred by the LORD will fall into it.

verses.kjv: Foolishness is bound in the heart of a child; but the rod of correction shall drive it far from him.
verses.modern: Foolishness is bound in the heart of a child, but the rod of correction will drive it far from Him.

verses.kjv: He that oppresseth the poor to increase his riches, and he that giveth to the rich, shall surely come to want.
verses.modern: He who oppresses the poor to increase his riches, and He who gives to the rich, will surely come to poverty.

verses.kjv: Bow down thine ear, and hear the words of the wise, and apply thine heart unto my knowledge.
verses.modern: Bow down Your ear and hear the words of the wise, and apply Your heart to my knowledge.

verses.kjv: For it is a pleasant thing if thou keep them within thee; they shall withal be fitted in thy lips.
verses.modern: For it is a pleasant thing if You keep them within You; they will be ready on Your lips.

verses.kjv: That thy trust may be in the LORD, I have made known to thee this day, even to thee.
verses.modern: So that Your trust may be in the LORD, I have made known to You this day, even to You.

verses.kjv: Have not I written to thee excellent things in counsels and knowledge,
verses.modern: Have I not written to You excellent things in counsels and knowledge,

verses.kjv: That I might make thee know the certainty of the words of truth; that thou mightest answer the words of truth to them that send unto thee?
verses.modern: so that I might make You know the certainty of the words of truth, that You might answer the words of truth to those who send to You?

verses.kjv: Rob not the poor, because he is poor: neither oppress the afflicted in the gate:
verses.modern: Do not rob the poor because He is poor, nor oppress the afflicted in the gate,

verses.kjv: For the LORD will plead their cause, and spoil the soul of those that spoiled them.
verses.modern: for the LORD will plead their cause, and plunder the soul of those who plundered them.

verses.kjv: Make no friendship with an angry man; and with a furious man thou shalt not go:
verses.modern: Make no friendship with an angry man, and with a furious man do not go,

verses.kjv: Lest thou learn his ways, and get a snare to thy soul.
verses.modern: lest You learn His ways and bring a snare to Your soul.

verses.kjv: Be not thou one of them that strike hands, or of them that are sureties for debts.
verses.modern: Do not be one of those who strike hands in pledge, or those who are sureties for debts.

verses.kjv: If thou hast nothing to pay, why should he take away thy bed from under thee?
verses.modern: If You have nothing to pay, why should He take away Your bed from under You?

verses.kjv: Remove not the ancient landmark, which thy fathers have set.
verses.modern: Do not remove the ancient landmark which Your fathers have set.

verses.kjv: Seest thou a man diligent in his business? he shall stand before kings; he shall not stand before mean men.
verses.modern: Do You see a man diligent in his business? He will stand before kings; He will not stand before lowly men.

chapters.summary: Contrasting proverbs address the value of a good name above riches, the training of a child in the way he should go, the snares of the strange woman, and the duty not to rob the poor or crush the afflicted. The chapter transitions into the sayings of the wise, beginning a section of longer counsels.

verses.kjv: When thou sittest to eat with a ruler, consider diligently what is before thee:
verses.modern: When you sit down to eat with a ruler, consider diligently what is before you,

verses.kjv: And put a knife to thy throat, if thou be a man given to appetite.
verses.modern: and put a knife to your throat if you are a man given to appetite.

verses.kjv: Be not desirous of his dainties: for they are deceitful meat.
verses.modern: Do not desire his delicacies, for they are deceitful food.

verses.kjv: Labour not to be rich: cease from thine own wisdom.
verses.modern: Do not labor to be rich; cease from your own wisdom.

verses.kjv: Wilt thou set thine eyes upon that which is not? for riches certainly make themselves wings; they fly away as an eagle toward heaven.
verses.modern: Will you set your eyes on what is not? For riches certainly make themselves wings; they fly away like an eagle toward heaven.

verses.kjv: Eat thou not the bread of him that hath an evil eye, neither desire thou his dainty meats:
verses.modern: Do not eat the bread of him who has an evil eye, nor desire his delicacies,

verses.kjv: For as he thinketh in his heart, so is he: Eat and drink, saith he to thee; but his heart is not with thee.
verses.modern: for as he thinks in his heart, so is he. "Eat and drink," he says to you, but his heart is not with you.

verses.kjv: The morsel which thou hast eaten shalt thou vomit up, and lose thy sweet words.
verses.modern: The morsel you have eaten you will vomit up, and lose your sweet words.

verses.kjv: Speak not in the ears of a fool: for he will despise the wisdom of thy words.
verses.modern: Do not speak in the ears of a fool, for he will despise the wisdom of your words.

verses.kjv: Remove not the old landmark; and enter not into the fields of the fatherless:
verses.modern: Do not remove the old landmark, and do not enter the fields of the fatherless,

verses.kjv: For their redeemer is mighty; he shall plead their cause with thee.
verses.modern: for their Redeemer is mighty; he will plead their cause against you.

verses.kjv: Apply thine heart unto instruction, and thine ears to the words of knowledge.
verses.modern: Apply your heart to instruction, and your ears to the words of knowledge.

verses.kjv: Withhold not correction from the child: for if thou beatest him with the rod, he shall not die.
verses.modern: Do not withhold correction from a child, for if you strike him with the rod, he will not die.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt beat him with the rod, and shalt deliver his soul from hell.
verses.modern: You will strike him with the rod, and deliver his soul from hell.

verses.kjv: My son, if thine heart be wise, my heart shall rejoice, even mine.
verses.modern: My son, if your heart is wise, my heart will rejoice, indeed mine.

verses.kjv: Yea, my reins shall rejoice, when thy lips speak right things.
verses.modern: Yes, my inmost being will rejoice when your lips speak right things.

verses.kjv: Let not thine heart envy sinners: but be thou in the fear of the LORD all the day long.
verses.modern: Do not let Your heart envy sinners; but be in the fear of the LORD all the day long.

verses.kjv: For surely there is an end; and thine expectation shall not be cut off.
verses.modern: For surely there is an end, and Your expectation will not be cut off.

verses.kjv: Hear thou, my son, and be wise, and guide thine heart in the way.
verses.modern: Hear, my son, and be wise, and guide Your heart in the way.

verses.kjv: Be not among winebibbers; among riotous eaters of flesh:
verses.modern: Do not be among heavy drinkers, among gluttonous eaters of meat,

verses.kjv: For the drunkard and the glutton shall come to poverty: and drowsiness shall clothe a man with rags.
verses.modern: for the drunkard and the glutton will come to poverty, and drowsiness will clothe a man with rags.

verses.kjv: Hearken unto thy father that begat thee, and despise not thy mother when she is old.
verses.modern: Listen to Your father who begot You, and do not despise Your mother when she is old.

verses.kjv: Buy the truth, and sell it not; also wisdom, and instruction, and understanding.
verses.modern: Buy the truth, and do not sell it; also wisdom, instruction, and understanding.

verses.kjv: The father of the righteous shall greatly rejoice: and he that begetteth a wise child shall have joy of him.
verses.modern: The father of the righteous will greatly rejoice, and he who begets a wise child will have joy in him.

verses.kjv: Thy father and thy mother shall be glad, and she that bare thee shall rejoice.
verses.modern: Your father and Your mother will be glad, and she who bore You will rejoice.

verses.kjv: My son, give me thine heart, and let thine eyes observe my ways.
verses.modern: My son, give me Your heart, and let Your eyes observe my ways.

verses.kjv: For a whore is a deep ditch; and a strange woman is a narrow pit.
verses.modern: For a harlot is a deep ditch, and a strange woman is a narrow pit.

verses.kjv: She also lieth in wait as for a prey, and increaseth the transgressors among men.
verses.modern: She also lies in wait as for prey, and increases the transgressors among men.

verses.kjv: Who hath woe? who hath sorrow? who hath contentions? who hath babbling? who hath wounds without cause? who hath redness of eyes?
verses.modern: Who has woe? Who has sorrow? Who has contentions? Who has babbling? Who has wounds without cause? Who has redness of eyes?

verses.kjv: They that tarry long at the wine; they that go to seek mixed wine.
verses.modern: Those who linger long at the wine, those who go to seek mixed wine.

verses.kjv: Look not thou upon the wine when it is red, when it giveth his colour in the cup, when it moveth itself aright.
verses.modern: Do not look on the wine when it is red, when it gives its color in the cup, when it moves itself rightly.

verses.kjv: At the last it biteth like a serpent, and stingeth like an adder.
verses.modern: At the last, it bites like a serpent and stings like an adder.

verses.kjv: Thine eyes shall behold strange women, and thine heart shall utter perverse things.
verses.modern: Your eyes will look on strange women, and Your heart will utter perverse things.

verses.kjv: Yea, thou shalt be as he that lieth down in the midst of the sea, or as he that lieth upon the top of a mast.
verses.modern: Yes, You will be like one who lies down in the midst of the sea, or like one who lies on top of a mast.

verses.kjv: They have stricken me, shalt thou say, and I was not sick; they have beaten me, and I felt it not: when shall I awake? I will seek it yet again.
verses.modern: "They have struck me," you will say, "but I was not hurt; they have beaten me, but I felt it not. When will I awake? I will seek it yet again."

chapters.summary: The wise man warns against craving a ruler's delicacies, laboring only to be rich, eating the bread of a man with an evil eye, and the sorrow of those who linger long at the wine. He pleads with his son to give him his heart and to let his eyes observe the father's ways.

verses.kjv: Be not thou envious against evil men, neither desire to be with them.
verses.modern: Do not be envious of evil men, nor desire to be with them.

verses.kjv: For their heart studieth destruction, and their lips talk of mischief.
verses.modern: For their heart studies destruction, and their lips talk of mischief.

verses.kjv: Through wisdom is an house builded; and by understanding it is established:
verses.modern: Through wisdom a house is built, and by understanding it is established.

verses.kjv: And by knowledge shall the chambers be filled with all precious and pleasant riches.
verses.modern: And by knowledge the chambers will be filled with all precious and pleasant riches.

verses.kjv: A wise man is strong; yea, a man of knowledge increaseth strength.
verses.modern: A wise man is strong; indeed, a man of knowledge increases strength.

verses.kjv: For by wise counsel thou shalt make thy war: and in multitude of counsellors there is safety.
verses.modern: For by wise counsel you will wage your war, and in the multitude of counselors there is safety.

verses.kjv: Wisdom is too high for a fool: he openeth not his mouth in the gate.
verses.modern: Wisdom is too high for a fool; he does not open his mouth in the gate.

verses.kjv: He that deviseth to do evil shall be called a mischievous person.
verses.modern: He who devises to do evil will be called a mischievous person.

verses.kjv: The thought of foolishness is sin: and the scorner is an abomination to men.
verses.modern: The thought of foolishness is sin, and the scorner is an abomination to men.

verses.kjv: If thou faint in the day of adversity, thy strength is small.
verses.modern: If you faint in the day of adversity, your strength is small.

verses.kjv: If thou forbear to deliver them that are drawn unto death, and those that are ready to be slain;
verses.modern: If you fail to deliver those who are drawn to death, and those who are ready to be slain —

verses.kjv: If thou sayest, Behold, we knew it not; doth not he that pondereth the heart consider it? and he that keepeth thy soul, doth not he know it? and shall not he render to every man according to his works?
verses.modern: if you say, "We did not know it," does not he who ponders the heart consider it? And he who keeps your soul, does he not know it? And will he not render to every man according to his works?

verses.kjv: My son, eat thou honey, because it is good; and the honeycomb, which is sweet to thy taste:
verses.modern: My son, eat honey, because it is good, and the honeycomb, which is sweet to your taste.

verses.kjv: So shall the knowledge of wisdom be unto thy soul: when thou hast found it, then there shall be a reward, and thy expectation shall not be cut off.
verses.modern: So will the knowledge of wisdom be to your soul; when you have found it, there will be a reward, and your expectation will not be cut off.

verses.kjv: Lay not wait, O wicked man, against the dwelling of the righteous; spoil not his resting place:
verses.modern: Do not lie in wait, O wicked man, against the dwelling of the righteous; do not plunder his resting place.

verses.kjv: For a just man falleth seven times, and riseth up again: but the wicked shall fall into mischief.
verses.modern: For a just man falls seven times and rises again; but the wicked will fall into mischief.

verses.kjv: Rejoice not when thine enemy falleth, and let not thine heart be glad when he stumbleth:
verses.modern: Do not rejoice when your enemy falls, and do not let your heart be glad when he stumbles,

verses.kjv: Lest the LORD see it, and it displease him, and he turn away his wrath from him.
verses.modern: lest the LORD see it and it displease Him, and He turn away His wrath from Him.

verses.kjv: Fret not thyself because of evil men, neither be thou envious at the wicked:
verses.modern: Do not fret yourself because of evil men, nor be envious of the wicked,

verses.kjv: For there shall be no reward to the evil man; the candle of the wicked shall be put out.
verses.modern: for there will be no reward to the evil man; the candle of the wicked will be put out.

verses.kjv: My son, fear thou the LORD and the king: and meddle not with them that are given to change:
verses.modern: My son, fear the LORD and the king, and do not associate with those who are given to change,

verses.kjv: For their calamity shall rise suddenly; and who knoweth the ruin of them both?
verses.modern: for their calamity will rise suddenly, and who knows the ruin of them both?

verses.kjv: These things also belong to the wise. It is not good to have respect of persons in judgment.
verses.modern: These things also belong to the wise: It is not good to show partiality in judgment.

verses.kjv: He that saith unto the wicked, Thou art righteous; him shall the people curse, nations shall abhor him:
verses.modern: He who says to the wicked, "You are righteous," him the people will curse, and nations will abhor him;

verses.kjv: But to them that rebuke him shall be delight, and a good blessing shall come upon them.
verses.modern: but to those who rebuke him there will be delight, and a good blessing will come on them.

verses.kjv: Every man shall kiss his lips that giveth a right answer.
verses.modern: Every man will kiss the lips of him who gives a right answer.

verses.kjv: Prepare thy work without, and make it fit for thyself in the field; and afterwards build thine house.
verses.modern: Prepare your work outside, and make it ready for yourself in the field; afterward build your house.

verses.kjv: Be not a witness against thy neighbour without cause; and deceive not with thy lips.
verses.modern: Do not be a witness against your neighbor without cause, and do not deceive with your lips.

verses.kjv: Say not, I will do so to him as he hath done to me: I will render to the man according to his work.
verses.modern: Do not say, "I will do to him as he has done to me; I will repay the man according to his work."

verses.kjv: I went by the field of the slothful, and by the vineyard of the man void of understanding;
verses.modern: I went by the field of the slothful and by the vineyard of the man without understanding,

verses.kjv: And, lo, it was all grown over with thorns, and nettles had covered the face thereof, and the stone wall thereof was broken down.
verses.modern: and it was all grown over with thorns, nettles had covered its surface, and its stone wall was broken down.

verses.kjv: Then I saw, and considered it well: I looked upon it, and received instruction.
verses.modern: Then I saw and considered it well; I looked on it and received instruction.

verses.kjv: Yet a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep:
verses.modern: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep —

verses.kjv: So shall thy poverty come as one that travelleth; and thy want as an armed man.
verses.modern: so your poverty will come like a wanderer, and your need like an armed man.

chapters.summary: The wise man warns against envying the wicked and counsels the value of wisdom, strength in adversity, and rescuing those being led to death. The chapter closes with the lesson of the sluggard's vineyard — overgrown and broken down — teaching that poverty comes like an armed man to the one who loves sleep.

verses.kjv: These are also proverbs of Solomon, which the men of Hezekiah king of Judah copied out.
verses.modern: These are also proverbs of Solomon, which the men of Hezekiah king of Judah copied out.

verses.kjv: It is the glory of God to conceal a thing: but the honour of kings is to search out a matter.
verses.modern: It is the glory of God to conceal a thing; but the honor of kings is to search out a matter.

verses.kjv: The heaven for height, and the earth for depth, and the heart of kings is unsearchable.
verses.modern: The heaven for height, the earth for depth, and the heart of kings are unsearchable.

verses.kjv: Take away the dross from the silver, and there shall come forth a vessel for the finer.
verses.modern: Take away the dross from the silver, and there will come forth a vessel for the refiner.

verses.kjv: Take away the wicked from before the king, and his throne shall be established in righteousness.
verses.modern: Take away the wicked from before the king, and his throne will be established in righteousness.

verses.kjv: Put not forth thyself in the presence of the king, and stand not in the place of great men:
verses.modern: Do not exalt yourself in the presence of the king, and do not stand in the place of great men,

verses.kjv: For better it is that it be said unto thee, Come up hither; than that thou shouldest be put lower in the presence of the prince whom thine eyes have seen.
verses.modern: for it is better that it be said to you, "Come up here," than that you should be put lower in the presence of the prince whom your eyes have seen.

verses.kjv: Go not forth hastily to strive, lest thou know not what to do in the end thereof, when thy neighbour hath put thee to shame.
verses.modern: Do not go forth hastily to strive, lest you know not what to do in the end, when your neighbor has put you to shame.

verses.kjv: Debate thy cause with thy neighbour himself; and discover not a secret to another:
verses.modern: Debate your cause with your neighbor himself, and do not disclose a secret to another,

verses.kjv: Lest he that heareth it put thee to shame, and thine infamy turn not away.
verses.modern: lest he who hears it put you to shame, and your bad name not turn away.

verses.kjv: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in pictures of silver.
verses.modern: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in settings of silver.

verses.kjv: As an earring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold, so is a wise reprover upon an obedient ear.
verses.modern: Like an earring of gold and an ornament of fine gold, so is a wise reprover to an obedient ear.

verses.kjv: As the cold of snow in the time of harvest, so is a faithful messenger to them that send him: for he refresheth the soul of his masters.
verses.modern: Like the cold of snow in the time of harvest is a faithful messenger to those who send him, for he refreshes the soul of his masters.

verses.kjv: Whoso boasteth himself of a false gift is like clouds and wind without rain.
verses.modern: Whoever boasts of a false gift is like clouds and wind without rain.

verses.kjv: By long forbearing is a prince persuaded, and a soft tongue breaketh the bone.
verses.modern: By long patience a prince is persuaded, and a soft tongue breaks the bone.

verses.kjv: Hast thou found honey? eat so much as is sufficient for thee, lest thou be filled therewith, and vomit it.
verses.modern: Have you found honey? Eat only as much as is enough for you, lest you be filled with it and vomit.

verses.kjv: Withdraw thy foot from thy neighbour's house; lest he be weary of thee, and so hate thee.
verses.modern: Withdraw your foot from your neighbor's house, lest he be weary of you and so hate you.

verses.kjv: A man that beareth false witness against his neighbour is a maul, and a sword, and a sharp arrow.
verses.modern: A man who bears false witness against his neighbor is a club, a sword, and a sharp arrow.

verses.kjv: Confidence in an unfaithful man in time of trouble is like a broken tooth, and a foot out of joint.
verses.modern: Confidence in an unfaithful man in time of trouble is like a broken tooth and a foot out of joint.

verses.kjv: As he that taketh away a garment in cold weather, and as vinegar upon nitre, so is he that singeth songs to an heavy heart.
verses.modern: Like one who takes away a garment in cold weather, and like vinegar on soda, so is he who sings songs to a heavy heart.

verses.kjv: If thine enemy be hungry, give him bread to eat; and if he be thirsty, give him water to drink:
verses.modern: If your enemy is hungry, give him bread to eat; if he is thirsty, give him water to drink.

verses.kjv: For thou shalt heap coals of fire upon his head, and the LORD shall reward thee.
verses.modern: For You will heap coals of fire on His head, and the LORD will reward You.

verses.kjv: The north wind driveth away rain: so doth an angry countenance a backbiting tongue.
verses.modern: The north wind drives away rain, and so does an angry countenance a backbiting tongue.

verses.kjv: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop, than with a brawling woman and in a wide house.
verses.modern: It is better to live in the corner of the housetop than with a contentious woman in a wide house.

verses.kjv: As cold waters to a thirsty soul, so is good news from a far country.
verses.modern: Like cold waters to a thirsty soul is good news from a far country.

verses.kjv: A righteous man falling down before the wicked is as a troubled fountain, and a corrupt spring.
verses.modern: A righteous man falling down before the wicked is like a troubled fountain and a corrupt spring.

verses.kjv: It is not good to eat much honey: so for men to search their own glory is not glory.
verses.modern: It is not good to eat much honey, and for men to search their own glory is not glory.

verses.kjv: He that hath no rule over his own spirit is like a city that is broken down, and without walls.
verses.modern: He who has no rule over his own spirit is like a city broken down and without walls.

chapters.summary: The Hezekiah collection begins with proverbs about conduct before kings, the value of a timely word, and the danger of false boasting. Memorable images abound: cold water to a weary soul, vinegar on a wound, coals of fire on an enemy's head, and a city without walls for the man who has no self-control.

verses.kjv: As snow in summer, and as rain in harvest, so honour is not seemly for a fool.
verses.modern: Like snow in summer and rain in harvest, so honor is not fitting for a fool.

verses.kjv: As the bird by wandering, as the swallow by flying, so the curse causeless shall not come.
verses.modern: Like the bird that wanders and the swallow in flight, so a causeless curse will not come to rest.

verses.kjv: A whip for the horse, a bridle for the ass, and a rod for the fool's back.
verses.modern: A whip for the horse, a bridle for the donkey, and a rod for the fool's back.

verses.kjv: Answer not a fool according to his folly, lest thou also be like unto him.
verses.modern: Do not answer a fool according to his folly, lest you also be like him.

verses.kjv: Answer a fool according to his folly, lest he be wise in his own conceit.
verses.modern: Answer a fool according to his folly, lest he be wise in his own conceit.

verses.kjv: He that sendeth a message by the hand of a fool cutteth off the feet, and drinketh damage.
verses.modern: He who sends a message by the hand of a fool cuts off his own feet and drinks damage.

verses.kjv: The legs of the lame are not equal: so is a parable in the mouth of fools.
verses.modern: The legs of the lame are not equal, and so is a parable in the mouth of fools.

verses.kjv: As he that bindeth a stone in a sling, so is he that giveth honour to a fool.
verses.modern: Like one who binds a stone in a sling, so is he who gives honor to a fool.

verses.kjv: As a thorn goeth up into the hand of a drunkard, so is a parable in the mouth of fools.
verses.modern: Like a thorn that goes into the hand of a drunkard, so is a parable in the mouth of fools.

verses.kjv: The great God that formed all things both rewardeth the fool, and rewardeth transgressors.
verses.modern: The great God Who formed all things rewards both the fool and the transgressors.

verses.kjv: As a dog returneth to his vomit, so a fool returneth to his folly.
verses.modern: As a dog returns to his vomit, so a fool returns to his folly.

verses.kjv: Seest thou a man wise in his own conceit? there is more hope of a fool than of him.
verses.modern: Do you see a man wise in his own conceit? There is more hope for a fool than for him.

verses.kjv: The slothful man saith, There is a lion in the way; a lion is in the streets.
verses.modern: The slothful man says, "There is a lion in the way; a lion is in the streets!"

verses.kjv: As the door turneth upon his hinges, so doth the slothful upon his bed.
verses.modern: As the door turns on its hinges, so does the slothful on his bed.

verses.kjv: The slothful hideth his hand in his bosom; it grieveth him to bring it again to his mouth.
verses.modern: The slothful hides his hand in his bosom; it grieves him to bring it again to his mouth.

verses.kjv: The sluggard is wiser in his own conceit than seven men that can render a reason.
verses.modern: The sluggard is wiser in his own conceit than seven men who can give a reason.

verses.kjv: He that passeth by, and meddleth with strife belonging not to him, is like one that taketh a dog by the ears.
verses.modern: He who passes by and meddles in a strife not belonging to him is like one who takes a dog by the ears.

verses.kjv: As a mad man who casteth firebrands, arrows, and death,
verses.modern: Like a madman who casts firebrands, arrows, and death,

verses.kjv: So is the man that deceiveth his neighbour, and saith, Am not I in sport?
verses.modern: so is the man who deceives his neighbor and says, "Am I not in sport?"

verses.kjv: Where no wood is, there the fire goeth out: so where there is no talebearer, the strife ceaseth.
verses.modern: Where there is no wood, the fire goes out, and where there is no talebearer, strife ceases.

verses.kjv: As coals are to burning coals, and wood to fire; so is a contentious man to kindle strife.
verses.modern: As coals are to burning coals, and wood to fire, so is a contentious man for kindling strife.

verses.kjv: The words of a talebearer are as wounds, and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly.
verses.modern: The words of a talebearer are like wounds, and they go down to the innermost parts of the belly.

verses.kjv: Burning lips and a wicked heart are like a potsherd covered with silver dross.
verses.modern: Burning lips and a wicked heart are like a potsherd covered with silver dross.

verses.kjv: He that hateth dissembleth with his lips, and layeth up deceit within him;
verses.modern: He who hates disguises it with his lips and stores up deceit within him;

verses.kjv: When he speaketh fair, believe him not: for there are seven abominations in his heart.
verses.modern: when he speaks fair words, do not believe him, for there are seven abominations in his heart.

verses.kjv: Whose hatred is covered by deceit, his wickedness shall be shewed before the whole congregation.
verses.modern: Though his hatred is covered by deceit, his wickedness will be shown before the whole congregation.

verses.kjv: Whoso diggeth a pit shall fall therein: and he that rolleth a stone, it will return upon him.
verses.modern: Whoever digs a pit will fall into it, and he who rolls a stone, it will return on him.

verses.kjv: A lying tongue hateth those that are afflicted by it; and a flattering mouth worketh ruin.
verses.modern: A lying tongue hates those who are afflicted by it, and a flattering mouth works ruin.

chapters.summary: Contrasting proverbs address the fool (honor is not fitting for him, and answering him requires discernment), the sluggard who turns on his bed like a door on its hinges, and the danger of deceit, gossip, and flattering lips. The meddler, the tale-bearer, and the man who hides hatred behind fair words are all exposed.

verses.kjv: Boast not thyself of to morrow; for thou knowest not what a day may bring forth.
verses.modern: Do not boast of tomorrow, for you do not know what a day may bring forth.

verses.kjv: Let another man praise thee, and not thine own mouth; a stranger, and not thine own lips.
verses.modern: Let another man praise you, and not your own mouth; a stranger, and not your own lips.

verses.kjv: A stone is heavy, and the sand weighty; but a fool's wrath is heavier than them both.
verses.modern: A stone is heavy, and the sand weighty, but a fool's wrath is heavier than them both.

verses.kjv: Wrath is cruel, and anger is outrageous; but who is able to stand before envy?
verses.modern: Wrath is cruel and anger is outrageous, but who is able to stand before envy?

verses.kjv: Open rebuke is better than secret love.
verses.modern: Open rebuke is better than secret love.

verses.kjv: Faithful are the wounds of a friend; but the kisses of an enemy are deceitful.
verses.modern: Faithful are the wounds of a friend, but the kisses of an enemy are deceitful.

verses.kjv: The full soul loatheth an honeycomb; but to the hungry soul every bitter thing is sweet.
verses.modern: The full soul loathes a honeycomb, but to the hungry soul every bitter thing is sweet.

verses.kjv: As a bird that wandereth from her nest, so is a man that wandereth from his place.
verses.modern: As a bird that wanders from her nest, so is a man who wanders from his place.

verses.kjv: Ointment and perfume rejoice the heart: so doth the sweetness of a man's friend by hearty counsel.
verses.modern: Ointment and perfume rejoice the heart, and so does the sweetness of a man's friend by hearty counsel.

verses.kjv: Thine own friend, and thy father's friend, forsake not; neither go into thy brother's house in the day of thy calamity: for better is a neighbour that is near than a brother far off.
verses.modern: Do not forsake your own friend, or your father's friend, and do not go to your brother's house in the day of your calamity. Better is a neighbor who is near than a brother far off.

verses.kjv: My son, be wise, and make my heart glad, that I may answer him that reproacheth me.
verses.modern: My son, be wise and make my heart glad, that I may answer him who reproaches me.

verses.kjv: A prudent man foreseeth the evil, and hideth himself; but the simple pass on, and are punished.
verses.modern: A prudent man foresees the evil and hides himself, but the simple pass on and are punished.

verses.kjv: Take his garment that is surety for a stranger, and take a pledge of him for a strange woman.
verses.modern: Take the garment of him who is surety for a stranger, and take a pledge from him for a strange woman.

verses.kjv: He that blesseth his friend with a loud voice, rising early in the morning, it shall be counted a curse to him.
verses.modern: He who blesses his friend with a loud voice, rising early in the morning, it will be counted a curse to him.

verses.kjv: A continual dropping in a very rainy day and a contentious woman are alike.
verses.modern: A continual dripping in a very rainy day and a contentious woman are alike.

verses.kjv: Whosoever hideth her hideth the wind, and the ointment of his right hand, which bewrayeth itself.
verses.modern: Whoever hides her hides the wind, and the ointment of his right hand betrays itself.

verses.kjv: Iron sharpeneth iron; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend.
verses.modern: Iron sharpens iron, and so a man sharpens the countenance of his friend.

verses.kjv: Whoso keepeth the fig tree shall eat the fruit thereof: so he that waiteth on his master shall be honoured.
verses.modern: Whoever keeps the fig tree will eat its fruit, and he who waits on his master will be honored.

verses.kjv: As in water face answereth to face, so the heart of man to man.
verses.modern: As in water face answers to face, so the heart of man to man.

verses.kjv: Hell and destruction are never full; so the eyes of man are never satisfied.
verses.modern: Hell and destruction are never full, and so the eyes of man are never satisfied.

verses.kjv: As the fining pot for silver, and the furnace for gold; so is a man to his praise.
verses.modern: As the refining pot for silver, and the furnace for gold, so is a man tested by his praise.

verses.kjv: Though thou shouldest bray a fool in a mortar among wheat with a pestle, yet will not his foolishness depart from him.
verses.modern: Though you should grind a fool in a mortar among wheat with a pestle, yet his foolishness will not depart from him.

verses.kjv: Be thou diligent to know the state of thy flocks, and look well to thy herds.
verses.modern: Be diligent to know the state of your flocks, and look well to your herds,

verses.kjv: For riches are not for ever: and doth the crown endure to every generation?
verses.modern: for riches are not forever, and does the crown endure to every generation?

verses.kjv: The hay appeareth, and the tender grass sheweth itself, and herbs of the mountains are gathered.
verses.modern: The hay appears, the tender grass shows itself, and the herbs of the mountains are gathered.

verses.kjv: The lambs are for thy clothing, and the goats are the price of the field.
verses.modern: The lambs are for your clothing, and the goats are the price of the field.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt have goats' milk enough for thy food, for the food of thy household, and for the maintenance for thy maidens.
verses.modern: You will have goats' milk enough for your food, for the food of your household, and for the maintenance of your maidens.

chapters.summary: Contrasting proverbs address the uncertainty of tomorrow, the value of open rebuke over hidden love, the sharpening of friend by friend as iron sharpens iron, and the restless stirring of envy. The chapter urges diligence in knowing the state of one's flocks, for riches do not endure forever.

verses.kjv: The wicked flee when no man pursueth: but the righteous are bold as a lion.
verses.modern: The wicked flee when no one pursues; but the righteous are as bold as a lion.

verses.kjv: For the transgression of a land many are the princes thereof: but by a man of understanding and knowledge the state thereof shall be prolonged.
verses.modern: For the transgression of a land, its princes are many; but by a man of understanding and knowledge, its state will be prolonged.

verses.kjv: A poor man that oppresseth the poor is like a sweeping rain which leaveth no food.
verses.modern: A poor man who oppresses the poor is like a sweeping rain which leaves no food.

verses.kjv: They that forsake the law praise the wicked: but such as keep the law contend with them.
verses.modern: Those who forsake the law praise the wicked; but those who keep the law contend with them.

verses.kjv: Evil men understand not judgment: but they that seek the LORD understand all things.
verses.modern: Evil men do not understand judgment; but those who seek the LORD understand all things.

verses.kjv: Better is the poor that walketh in his uprightness, than he that is perverse in his ways, though he be rich.
verses.modern: Better is the poor who walks in His uprightness than He who is perverse in his ways, though he be rich.

verses.kjv: Whoso keepeth the law is a wise son: but he that is a companion of riotous men shameth his father.
verses.modern: Whoever keeps the law is a wise son; but he who is a companion of riotous men shames his father.

verses.kjv: He that by usury and unjust gain increaseth his substance, he shall gather it for him that will pity the poor.
verses.modern: He who by usury and unjust gain increases his substance will gather it for Him who will pity the poor.

verses.kjv: He that turneth away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer shall be abomination.
verses.modern: He who turns away his ear from hearing the law, even His prayer will be an abomination.

verses.kjv: Whoso causeth the righteous to go astray in an evil way, he shall fall himself into his own pit: but the upright shall have good things in possession.
verses.modern: Whoever causes the righteous to go astray in an evil way will himself fall into His own pit; but the upright will have good things in possession.

verses.kjv: The rich man is wise in his own conceit; but the poor that hath understanding searcheth him out.
verses.modern: The rich man is wise in his own conceit, but the poor who has understanding sees through him.

verses.kjv: When righteous men do rejoice, there is great glory: but when the wicked rise, a man is hidden.
verses.modern: When righteous men rejoice, there is great glory; but when the wicked rise, men hide themselves.

verses.kjv: He that covereth his sins shall not prosper: but whoso confesseth and forsaketh them shall have mercy.
verses.modern: He who covers his sins will not prosper; but whoever confesses and forsakes them will have mercy.

verses.kjv: Happy is the man that feareth alway: but he that hardeneth his heart shall fall into mischief.
verses.modern: Happy is the man who fears always; but he who hardens his heart will fall into mischief.

verses.kjv: As a roaring lion, and a ranging bear; so is a wicked ruler over the poor people.
verses.modern: Like a roaring lion and a charging bear, so is a wicked ruler over a poor people.

verses.kjv: The prince that wanteth understanding is also a great oppressor: but he that hateth covetousness shall prolong his days.
verses.modern: The prince who lacks understanding is also a great oppressor; but he who hates covetousness will prolong his days.

verses.kjv: A man that doeth violence to the blood of any person shall flee to the pit; let no man stay him.
verses.modern: A man who does violence to the blood of any person will flee to the pit; let no man hold him back.

verses.kjv: Whoso walketh uprightly shall be saved: but he that is perverse in his ways shall fall at once.
verses.modern: Whoever walks uprightly will be saved; but he who is perverse in his ways will fall at once.

verses.kjv: He that tilleth his land shall have plenty of bread: but he that followeth after vain persons shall have poverty enough.
verses.modern: He who tills his land will have plenty of bread; but he who follows worthless persons will have poverty enough.

verses.kjv: A faithful man shall abound with blessings: but he that maketh haste to be rich shall not be innocent.
verses.modern: A faithful man will abound with blessings; but he who hastens to be rich will not be innocent.

verses.kjv: To have respect of persons is not good: for for a piece of bread that man will transgress.
verses.modern: To show partiality is not good, for a piece of bread that man will transgress.

verses.kjv: He that hasteth to be rich hath an evil eye, and considereth not that poverty shall come upon him.
verses.modern: He who hastens to be rich has an evil eye and does not consider that poverty will come on him.

verses.kjv: He that rebuketh a man afterwards shall find more favour than he that flattereth with the tongue.
verses.modern: He who rebukes a man will afterward find more favor than he who flatters with the tongue.

verses.kjv: Whoso robbeth his father or his mother, and saith, It is no transgression; the same is the companion of a destroyer.
verses.modern: Whoever robs his father or his mother and says, "It is no transgression," is the companion of a destroyer.

verses.kjv: He that is of a proud heart stirreth up strife: but he that putteth his trust in the LORD shall be made fat.
verses.modern: He who is of a proud heart stirs up strife; but he who puts his trust in the LORD will be made rich.

verses.kjv: He that trusteth in his own heart is a fool: but whoso walketh wisely, he shall be delivered.
verses.modern: He who trusts in his own heart is a fool; but whoever walks wisely will be delivered.

verses.kjv: He that giveth unto the poor shall not lack: but he that hideth his eyes shall have many a curse.
verses.modern: He who gives to the poor will not lack; but he who hides his eyes will have many a curse.

verses.kjv: When the wicked rise, men hide themselves: but when they perish, the righteous increase.
verses.modern: When the wicked rise, men hide themselves; but when they perish, the righteous increase.

chapters.summary: Contrasting proverbs address the boldness of the righteous versus the flight of the wicked, the ruler who oppresses the poor, and the blessings that come to the faithful versus the haste that leads to poverty. He who trusts in his own heart is a fool, but whoever walks wisely will be delivered.

verses.kjv: He, that being often reproved hardeneth his neck, shall suddenly be destroyed, and that without remedy.
verses.modern: He who, being often corrected, hardens his neck will suddenly be destroyed, and that without remedy.

verses.kjv: When the righteous are in authority, the people rejoice: but when the wicked beareth rule, the people mourn.
verses.modern: When the righteous are in authority, the people rejoice; but when the wicked rule, the people mourn.

verses.kjv: Whoso loveth wisdom rejoiceth his father: but he that keepeth company with harlots spendeth his substance.
verses.modern: Whoever loves wisdom rejoices his father; but he who keeps company with harlots wastes his substance.

verses.kjv: The king by judgment establisheth the land: but he that receiveth gifts overthroweth it.
verses.modern: The king by judgment establishes the land; but he who receives bribes overthrows it.

verses.kjv: A man that flattereth his neighbour spreadeth a net for his feet.
verses.modern: A man who flatters his neighbor spreads a net for his feet.

verses.kjv: In the transgression of an evil man there is a snare: but the righteous doth sing and rejoice.
verses.modern: In the transgression of an evil man there is a snare; but the righteous sings and rejoices.

verses.kjv: The righteous considereth the cause of the poor: but the wicked regardeth not to know it.
verses.modern: The righteous considers the cause of the poor; but the wicked does not care to know it.

verses.kjv: Scornful men bring a city into a snare: but wise men turn away wrath.
verses.modern: Scornful men bring a city into a snare; but wise men turn away wrath.

verses.kjv: If a wise man contendeth with a foolish man, whether he rage or laugh, there is no rest.
verses.modern: If a wise man contends with a foolish man, whether he rages or laughs, there is no rest.

verses.kjv: The bloodthirsty hate the upright: but the just seek his soul.
verses.modern: The bloodthirsty hate the upright; but the just seek his soul.

verses.kjv: A fool uttereth all his mind: but a wise man keepeth it in till afterwards.
verses.modern: A fool utters all his mind; but a wise man keeps it in till afterward.

verses.kjv: If a ruler hearken to lies, all his servants are wicked.
verses.modern: If a ruler listens to lies, all his servants become wicked.

verses.kjv: The poor and the deceitful man meet together: the LORD lighteneth both their eyes.
verses.modern: The poor and the deceitful man meet together; the LORD enlightens the eyes of both.

verses.kjv: The king that faithfully judgeth the poor, his throne shall be established for ever.
verses.modern: The king who faithfully judges the poor, his throne will be established forever.

verses.kjv: The rod and reproof give wisdom: but a child left to himself bringeth his mother to shame.
verses.modern: The rod and reproof give wisdom; but a child left to himself brings his mother to shame.

verses.kjv: When the wicked are multiplied, transgression increaseth: but the righteous shall see their fall.
verses.modern: When the wicked are multiplied, transgression increases; but the righteous will see their fall.

verses.kjv: Correct thy son, and he shall give thee rest; yea, he shall give delight unto thy soul.
verses.modern: Correct your son, and he will give you rest; indeed, he will give delight to your soul.

verses.kjv: Where there is no vision, the people perish: but he that keepeth the law, happy is he.
verses.modern: Where there is no vision, the people perish; but he who keeps the law, happy is he.

verses.kjv: A servant will not be corrected by words: for though he understand he will not answer.
verses.modern: A servant will not be corrected by words, for though he understands, he will not answer.

verses.kjv: Seest thou a man that is hasty in his words? there is more hope of a fool than of him.
verses.modern: Do you see a man who is hasty in his words? There is more hope for a fool than for him.

verses.kjv: He that delicately bringeth up his servant from a child shall have him become his son at the length.
verses.modern: He who delicately raises his servant from a child will have him become his son in the end.

verses.kjv: An angry man stirreth up strife, and a furious man aboundeth in transgression.
verses.modern: An angry man stirs up strife, and a furious man abounds in transgression.

verses.kjv: A man's pride shall bring him low: but honour shall uphold the humble in spirit.
verses.modern: A man's pride will bring him low; but honor will uphold the humble in spirit.

verses.kjv: Whoso is partner with a thief hateth his own soul: he heareth cursing, and bewrayeth it not.
verses.modern: Whoever is partner with a thief hates his own soul; he hears cursing and does not reveal it.

verses.kjv: The fear of man bringeth a snare: but whoso putteth his trust in the LORD shall be safe.
verses.modern: The fear of man brings a snare; but whoever puts his trust in the LORD will be safe.

verses.kjv: Many seek the ruler's favour; but every man's judgment cometh from the LORD.
verses.modern: Many seek the ruler's favor, but every man's judgment comes from the LORD.

verses.kjv: An unjust man is an abomination to the just: and he that is upright in the way is abomination to the wicked.
verses.modern: An unjust man is an abomination to the just, and he who is upright in the way is an abomination to the wicked.

chapters.summary: Contrasting proverbs address the ruler who loves justice versus the ruler who listens to lies, the rod of correction that gives wisdom versus the child left to himself who brings shame, and the fear of man that brings a snare versus trust in the LORD that brings safety. Where there is no vision, the people perish.

verses.kjv: The words of Agur the son of Jakeh, even the prophecy: the man spake unto Ithiel, even unto Ithiel and Ucal,
verses.modern: The words of Agur the son of Jakeh, even the prophecy. The man said to Ithiel, even to Ithiel and Ucal:

verses.kjv: Surely I am more brutish than any man, and have not the understanding of a man.
verses.modern: Surely I am more brutish than any man, and do not have the understanding of a man.

verses.kjv: I neither learned wisdom, nor have the knowledge of the holy.
verses.modern: I have neither learned wisdom, nor have the knowledge of the Holy One.

verses.kjv: Who hath ascended up into heaven, or descended? who hath gathered the wind in his fists? who hath bound the waters in a garment? who hath established all the ends of the earth? what is his name, and what is his son's name, if thou canst tell?
verses.modern: Who has ascended up into heaven, or descended? Who has gathered the wind in His fists? Who has bound the waters in a garment? Who has established all the ends of the earth? What is His name, and what is His son's name, if You can tell?

verses.kjv: Every word of God is pure: he is a shield unto them that put their trust in him.
verses.modern: Every word of God is pure; He is a shield to those who put their trust in Him.

verses.kjv: Add thou not unto his words, lest he reprove thee, and thou be found a liar.
verses.modern: Do not add to His words, lest He rebuke You and You be found a liar.

verses.kjv: Two things have I required of thee; deny me them not before I die:
verses.modern: Two things I have asked of You; do not deny them to me before I die:

verses.kjv: Remove far from me vanity and lies: give me neither poverty nor riches; feed me with food convenient for me:
verses.modern: Remove far from me vanity and lies; give me neither poverty nor riches; feed me with the food that is needful for me,

verses.kjv: Lest I be full, and deny thee, and say, Who is the LORD? or lest I be poor, and steal, and take the name of my God in vain.
verses.modern: lest I be full and deny You, and say, "Who is the LORD?" or lest I be poor and steal, and take the name of my God in vain.

verses.kjv: Accuse not a servant unto his master, lest he curse thee, and thou be found guilty.
verses.modern: Do not accuse a servant to His master, lest He curse You, and You be found guilty.

verses.kjv: There is a generation that curseth their father, and doth not bless their mother.
verses.modern: There is a generation that curses their father and does not bless their mother.

verses.kjv: There is a generation that are pure in their own eyes, and yet is not washed from their filthiness.
verses.modern: There is a generation that is pure in their own eyes, yet is not washed from their filthiness.

verses.kjv: There is a generation, O how lofty are their eyes! and their eyelids are lifted up.
verses.modern: There is a generation, O how lofty are their eyes, and their eyelids are lifted up!

verses.kjv: There is a generation, whose teeth are as swords, and their jaw teeth as knives, to devour the poor from off the earth, and the needy from among men.
verses.modern: There is a generation whose teeth are like swords, and their jaw teeth like knives, to devour the poor from off the earth, and the needy from among men.

verses.kjv: The horseleach hath two daughters, crying, Give, give. There are three things that are never satisfied, yea, four things say not, It is enough:
verses.modern: The leech has two daughters, crying, "Give, give." There are three things that are never satisfied, indeed four things that do not say, "It is enough":

verses.kjv: The grave; and the barren womb; the earth that is not filled with water; and the fire that saith not, It is enough.
verses.modern: the grave, the barren womb, the earth that is not filled with water, and the fire that does not say, "It is enough."

verses.kjv: The eye that mocketh at his father, and despiseth to obey his mother, the ravens of the valley shall pick it out, and the young eagles shall eat it.
verses.modern: The eye that mocks at His father and despises to obey His mother, the ravens of the valley will pick it out, and the young eagles will eat it.

verses.kjv: There be three things which are too wonderful for me, yea, four which I know not:
verses.modern: There are three things which are too wonderful for me, indeed four which I do not know:

verses.kjv: The way of an eagle in the air; the way of a serpent upon a rock; the way of a ship in the midst of the sea; and the way of a man with a maid.
verses.modern: the way of an eagle in the air, the way of a serpent on a rock, the way of a ship in the midst of the sea, and the way of a man with a maid.

verses.kjv: Such is the way of an adulterous woman; she eateth, and wipeth her mouth, and saith, I have done no wickedness.
verses.modern: Such is the way of an adulterous woman: she eats and wipes her mouth, and says, "I have done no wickedness."

verses.kjv: For three things the earth is disquieted, and for four which it cannot bear:
verses.modern: For three things the earth is disquieted, and for four which it cannot bear:

verses.kjv: For a servant when he reigneth; and a fool when he is filled with meat;
verses.modern: for a servant when He reigns, and a fool when He is filled with food,

verses.kjv: For an odious woman when she is married; and an handmaid that is heir to her mistress.
verses.modern: for a hateful woman when she is married, and a handmaid who is heir to her mistress.

verses.kjv: There be four things which are little upon the earth, but they are exceeding wise:
verses.modern: There are four things which are little on the earth, but they are exceedingly wise:

verses.kjv: The ants are a people not strong, yet they prepare their meat in the summer;
verses.modern: the ants are a people not strong, yet they prepare their food in the summer;

verses.kjv: The conies are but a feeble folk, yet make they their houses in the rocks;
verses.modern: the conies are a feeble folk, yet they make their houses in the rocks;

verses.kjv: The locusts have no king, yet go they forth all of them by bands;
verses.modern: the locusts have no king, yet all of them go forth in bands;

verses.kjv: The spider taketh hold with her hands, and is in kings' palaces.
verses.modern: the spider takes hold with her hands, and is in kings' palaces.

verses.kjv: There be three things which go well, yea, four are comely in going:
verses.modern: There are three things which go well, indeed four are graceful in their going:

verses.kjv: A lion which is strongest among beasts, and turneth not away for any;
verses.modern: a lion, which is strongest among beasts and does not turn away for any;

verses.kjv: A greyhound; an he goat also; and a king, against whom there is no rising up.
verses.modern: a greyhound, a male goat also, and a king against whom there is no rising up.

verses.kjv: If thou hast done foolishly in lifting up thyself, or if thou hast thought evil, lay thine hand upon thy mouth.
verses.modern: If You have done foolishly in lifting up Yourself, or if You have thought evil, lay Your hand on Your mouth.

verses.kjv: Surely the churning of milk bringeth forth butter, and the wringing of the nose bringeth forth blood: so the forcing of wrath bringeth forth strife.
verses.modern: Surely the churning of milk brings forth butter, and the wringing of the nose brings forth blood; so the forcing of wrath brings forth strife.

chapters.summary: Agur speaks of his own ignorance before God, asks who has ascended into heaven, and prays for neither poverty nor riches. He catalogues the wonders of creation in numbered proverbs — things too wonderful, things never satisfied, things that are stately in their stride — exposing human pride against the backdrop of God's inscrutable works.

verses.kjv: The words of king Lemuel, the prophecy that his mother taught him.
verses.modern: The words of King Lemuel, the prophecy that His mother taught Him.

verses.kjv: What, my son? and what, the son of my womb? and what, the son of my vows?
verses.modern: What, my son? And what, the son of my womb? And what, the son of my vows?

verses.kjv: Give not thy strength unto women, nor thy ways to that which destroyeth kings.
verses.modern: Do not give Your strength to women, nor Your ways to that which destroys kings.

verses.kjv: It is not for kings, O Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine; nor for princes strong drink:
verses.modern: It is not for kings, O Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine, nor for princes strong drink,

verses.kjv: Lest they drink, and forget the law, and pervert the judgment of any of the afflicted.
verses.modern: lest they drink and forget the law, and pervert the judgment of any of the afflicted.

verses.kjv: Give strong drink unto him that is ready to perish, and wine unto those that be of heavy hearts.
verses.modern: Give strong drink to Him who is ready to perish, and wine to those who are of heavy hearts.

verses.kjv: Let him drink, and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.
verses.modern: Let Him drink and forget His poverty, and remember His misery no more.

verses.kjv: Open thy mouth for the dumb in the cause of all such as are appointed to destruction.
verses.modern: Open Your mouth for the mute in the cause of all such as are appointed to destruction.

verses.kjv: Open thy mouth, judge righteously, and plead the cause of the poor and needy.
verses.modern: Open Your mouth, judge righteously, and plead the cause of the poor and needy.

verses.kjv: Who can find a virtuous woman? for her price is far above rubies.
verses.modern: Who can find a virtuous woman? For her price is far above rubies.

verses.kjv: The heart of her husband doth safely trust in her, so that he shall have no need of spoil.
verses.modern: The heart of her husband safely trusts in her, so that He will have no need of spoil.

verses.kjv: She will do him good and not evil all the days of her life.
verses.modern: She will do Him good and not evil all the days of her life.

verses.kjv: She seeketh wool, and flax, and worketh willingly with her hands.
verses.modern: She seeks wool and flax, and works willingly with her hands.

verses.kjv: She is like the merchants' ships; she bringeth her food from afar.
verses.modern: She is like the merchants' ships; she brings her food from afar.

verses.kjv: She riseth also while it is yet night, and giveth meat to her household, and a portion to her maidens.
verses.modern: She rises also while it is yet night, and gives food to her household, and a portion to her maidens.

verses.kjv: She considereth a field, and buyeth it: with the fruit of her hands she planteth a vineyard.
verses.modern: She considers a field and buys it; with the fruit of her hands she plants a vineyard.

verses.kjv: She girdeth her loins with strength, and strengtheneth her arms.
verses.modern: She girds her loins with strength, and strengthens her arms.

verses.kjv: She perceiveth that her merchandise is good: her candle goeth not out by night.
verses.modern: She sees that her merchandise is good; her candle does not go out by night.

verses.kjv: She layeth her hands to the spindle, and her hands hold the distaff.
verses.modern: She lays her hands to the spindle, and her hands hold the distaff.

verses.kjv: She stretcheth out her hand to the poor; yea, she reacheth forth her hands to the needy.
verses.modern: She stretches out her hand to the poor; indeed, she reaches forth her hands to the needy.

verses.kjv: She is not afraid of the snow for her household: for all her household are clothed with scarlet.
verses.modern: She is not afraid of the snow for her household, for all her household are clothed with scarlet.

verses.kjv: She maketh herself coverings of tapestry; her clothing is silk and purple.
verses.modern: She makes herself coverings of tapestry; her clothing is silk and purple.

verses.kjv: Her husband is known in the gates, when he sitteth among the elders of the land.
verses.modern: Her husband is known in the gates, when He sits among the elders of the land.

verses.kjv: She maketh fine linen, and selleth it; and delivereth girdles unto the merchant.
verses.modern: She makes fine linen and sells it, and delivers sashes to the merchant.

verses.kjv: Strength and honour are her clothing; and she shall rejoice in time to come.
verses.modern: Strength and honor are her clothing, and she will rejoice in time to come.

verses.kjv: She openeth her mouth with wisdom; and in her tongue is the law of kindness.
verses.modern: She opens her mouth with wisdom, and on her tongue is the law of kindness.

verses.kjv: She looketh well to the ways of her household, and eateth not the bread of idleness.
verses.modern: She looks well to the ways of her household, and does not eat the bread of idleness.

verses.kjv: Her children arise up, and call her blessed; her husband also, and he praiseth her.
verses.modern: Her children rise up and call her blessed; her husband also, and He praises her:

verses.kjv: Many daughters have done virtuously, but thou excellest them all.
verses.modern: "Many daughters have done virtuously, but You excel them all."

verses.kjv: Favour is deceitful, and beauty is vain: but a woman that feareth the LORD, she shall be praised.
verses.modern: Favor is deceitful and beauty is vain; but a woman who fears the LORD, she will be praised.

verses.kjv: Give her of the fruit of her hands; and let her own works praise her in the gates.
verses.modern: Give her of the fruit of her hands, and let her own works praise her in the gates.

chapters.summary: King Lemuel's mother teaches him to avoid women and wine, to open his mouth for the voiceless and judge righteously for the poor, and the chapter closes with the acrostic portrait of the virtuous woman whose price is far above rubies. She works willingly, provides for her household, stretches out her hand to the poor, and fears the LORD — and her works praise her in the gates.
